title: Technical Lead
description:
Flightradar24 is one of the most successful growth-stage tech companies in Stockholm. Each month more than 80 million aviation enthusiasts visit Flightradar24, and our Commercial Services team works with some of the biggest names in aviation. We are looking for a Tech Lead to take ownership of the engineering efforts behind our full B2B product portfolio.
 



  





**Opportunity** 




 Flightradar24 is the world’s definitive source of flight data. While we lead the market in tracking the sky, our next frontier is to become the operational intelligence layer for the aviation industry.
 



  





 We are transitioning from a data-provider to an essential operational partner. We don't just track flights; we provide the predictive insights that allow airlines, airports, and manufacturers
 



 toincrease efficiencies, eliminate uncertainty and drive bottomline growth.
 



  





 We are seeking a Tech Lead to be the founding engineer of our B2B tech-team. You will have a leading role in our transformation as we productise our raw data into B2B products. You will work together with our Sales team to define what we need to build. You will then take ownership of architecture and technology choices to deliver reliable, scalable and safe solutions. As we scale, you will have the opportunity to build a world-class engineering team.
 



  





 The existing B2B portfolio includes, live data feeds, custom historical data exports, our public REST API service, and the business features of flightradar24.com. We have large volumes of ADS-B and other flight data, at different levels of granularity.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




 ● Own the engineering behind Flightradar24's entire B2B product portfolio, from customer-facing features to the underlying data pipelines and services
 



 ● Design and build scalable backend services powering live data feeds, APIs, historical exports, and new commercial products
 



 ● Work across the full technical stack where needed, from data lakehouse and databases through backend services to frontend applications
 



 ● Build new capabilities on top of Flightradar24's real-time aviation data, transforming raw aircraft telemetry into valuable products for customers
 



 ● Improve the scalability, reliability, observability, and operational excellence of production systems
 



 ● Work closely with platform, data, web, and infrastructure teams to integrate with thebroader Flightradar24 ecosystem
 



  





**About you** 




 ● Have several years of experience building and operating production software at scale
 



 ● Are comfortable working across different parts of a modern technology stack, from data platforms and databases to backend services and user-facing applications
 



 ● Can quickly understand complex existing systems, even when documentation is limited or the architecture has evolved over many years
 



 ● Balance pragmatic delivery with thoughtful engineering and know when to optimize and when to keep things simple
 



  





**Required technical competence** 




 ● Strong experience designing and building production fullstack systems
 



 ● Experience working with modern cloud platforms, preferably AWS
 



 ● Solid understanding of databases, distributed systems, and data architecture
 



 ● Experience with APIs, event-driven systems, streaming platforms, or large-scale data processing
 



 ● Comfortable working across multiple technology stacks and learning new technologies when
 



 needed
 



 ● Strong understanding of reliability, observability, testing, and production operations
 



  





**Current tech stack** 




 ● Web: PHP & Laravel & Vue
 



 ● Backend & Data: C++, Python, Go
 



 ● Cloud & Data Platform: AWS (S3, Glue/Spark, Airflow/MWAA, Athena, MSK/Kafka)
 



 ● Streaming & Messaging: Kafka, RabbitMQ
 



 ● Databases & Storage: SQL/NoSQL systems (e.g., MySQL/MariaDB/Postgres, Redis,DynamoDB, Hazelcast)
 



 ● DevOps & Platform: Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, Terraform
 



  





**About Flightradar24** 




 Flightradar24 is the leading flight tracking and aviation data provider, leveraging the world’s largest ADS-B network. Our B2C platform serves millions, while our B2B solutions empower airlines, airports, and aviation stakeholders with essential operational insights.
 



  





 All this is made possible thanks to our globally distributed network of 60,000+ radio receivers that feed real-time aircraft data into the Flightradar24 platform. Over a billion database entries are added each month and we are processing several years of historical data totalling many terabytes. Our proprietary flight tracking data is industry leading and even investigative government agencies from around the world rely on it for aviation accident investigations.

title: Backend Engineer - Anti-Cheat
description:
The Anti-cheat team at Embark is responsible for upholding the integrity of our games, identifying instances of unfair play, and protecting the experience of our players. We have a versatile toolbox at our disposal, which we continuously evolve and refine, including client-side protections, third-party systems, machine-learning models. Being a core function supporting all of Embark games, we collaborate with many different stakeholders throughout the organisation, such as game teams, legal and community management.
   

  

 We are now looking for a well rounded Backend engineer with front-end experience to strengthen our operational capacity. As a member of our Anti-cheat team you will, among other things, be responsible for maintaining and developing the services that power Embark’s anti-cheat activities, and develop tools and visualizations within our internal web portals supporting both our own and other teams at Embark.
   

  

 You are likely curious to continuously learn new skills. You enjoy working autonomously and taking initiatives, while also collaborating within and across teams. You enjoy applying the full breadth of your skill set to help protect our players from unfair play and malicious actors. By being creative and experimental you aim to solve problems in a game-changing way.
   

  

**Example Of Responsibilities**
* Operate, monitor and develop anti-cheat services critical to our live games
* Design and deploy internal services supporting the anti-cheat operation
* Work with internal users to design and develop web tools and visualizations


**We would love if you have**
* A creative and curious mind
* Proficiency in Go
* Proficiency in Typescript
* Experience in developing and operating distributed systems
* Experience in developing intuitive, easy-to-use, graphical interfaces
* Experience working with Google Cloud Platform
* Professional English communication skills
* Experience and/or interest in games and anti-cheat will be considered a bonus!


 At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.
   

  

 We welcome game makers of all sex, class, colour, age, gender identity, education, religion, opinion, culture, nation of origin, language, sexual orientation, shape, size, and ability.
   

  

 Did we leave anyone out? Well, we welcome you, too! We think that the gaming industry is made better when everyone has a seat at the table.
   

  

 Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

title: Backend Software Engineer (Node.js) - UniFi OS

To date, Ubiquiti has shipped over 100 million devices worldwide, from ISP networking products to next generation of IT solutions. title: Utvecklare
description:

* Delta i utvecklingen av våra produkter - från koncept till färdig produkt

* React, Typescript, Go, Java

 Vi söker dig som har minst 2 års arbetslivserfarenhet från en liknande roll. Du har god erfarenhet av backend-utveckling och kunskap inom frontend och databaser. Du har en förmåga att samarbeta effektivt i team, men tar också eget ansvar och levererar självständigt när det behövs. Du delar vår passion för att skapa högkvalitativa produkter och säkerställa en grym användarupplevelse för våra kunder.
   

  

 Du är nyfiken på att kontinuerligt bredda din kompetens och hitta nya tekniska lösningar. Hos oss finns det alltid utrymme för att testa egna idéer! Med det sagt så löser vi självklart främst problem tillsammans som ett team. Utöver dina tekniska kvalifikationer så värdesätter vi också ett intresse för, eller kunskap om börsen och finansvärlden. Ju mer domänkunskap våra medarbetare har, desto bättre och roligare blir det – även för våra utvecklare.

* Något frontend-Javascript-ramverk (helst React)

* Docker, Kubernetes
* Utveckling i cloud-miljö - GCP, AWS eller liknande

**Vad vi erbjuder**
* En arbetsplats som främjar lärande och kunskapsspridning inom vårt område
* Vi växer snabbt och för rätt person finns goda möjligheter till spännande utveckling inom bolaget
* Stark teamkänsla och gemensamma bolagsaktiviteter såsom månatliga AW:s och större event
* Ett stabilt bolag med konkurrenskraftig lön, tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag, sjukförsäkring och vårdförsäkring

**Anställningsform:** 
 Tillsvidareanställning med inledande provanställning om 6 månader
   

  

**Startdatum:** 
 Så snart som möjligt
   

  

**Placering:** 
 Stockholm. Vi tillämpar en hybridmodell med 5 valfria remotedagar i månaden.
   

  

 Välkommen att ansöka!
   

  

 Urvalet kommer att ske löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Vid frågor kring tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Jacob Schoerner, CTO, på jacob.schoerner@modularfinance.se.
   

  

 Vi kommer att svara på alla ansökningar.

title: Backend Engineer
description:
**The work** 





 You won’t be gluing COBOL together. Our core platform is a Java/Spring Boot monolith - deliberately so - that handles checkout flows, real-time credit decisions, bank clearing, AML compliance, multi-currency accounting, and direct integrations with European banks and payment providers.
 




  






 Every line of code you write has consequences. It moves money. It approves or denies credit. It talks to regulators. This is engineering where the edge cases aren’t theoretical - they’re someone’s car purchase failing at 2pm on a Sunday.
 




  





**The tech** 



* Java with Spring Boot
* PostgreSQL with 1500+ Flyway migrations - the schema tells the story of the company
* REST APIs with OpenAPI specs
* AWS, the good parts - EC2, S3, Bedrock etc
* Kubernetes to tie it all together



  





**What we’re really looking for** 





 Here’s the thing. AI can generate code now. That’s not a secret. What it can’t do - what it won’t do for a long time - is
 
*think* 

 about systems. Anticipate the failure mode nobody asked about. See the race condition hiding behind a perfectly reasonable-looking feature request. We need people who look at a spec and immediately start asking “what happens when...”
 

 We don’t care about your years of experience. We care about how you think.
 

 If that sounds like you, let’s talk.
 




  





**Bonus:** 



* Deep Java experience
* Strong SQL and PostgreSQL instincts
* An obsession with edge cases, failure modes, and the question “what could go wrong here?”
* The ability to hold a large, complex system in your head and reason about it



  





**Why Zaver** 





 World’s most efficient guerilla group - tight team, real problems. No middle management. The best ideas win. You’ll work directly on infrastructure that handles real money in different countries, and you’ll see your decisions play out in production.
 




  






 We’re building something that matters, with people who care about getting it right.
 
 Let’s challenge legacy solutions together and make some waves within payments ⚡

They offer localized solutions in 18 markets, tailored to specific languages, currencies, and payment methods.  In this role, you will develop and evolve Kustom’s checkout products, from the complete checkout experience to embeddable components that integrate into a wide range of online stores.  As a key member in the Checkout team, you’ll be at the forefront of crafting exceptional digital experiences. title: Tech Graduate - Stockholm
description:

* kommunicerar bra på ett skandinaviskt språk och engelska

* verkliga tekniska problemställningar tidigt, med kompetenta kollegor som stöd
* utveckla både bred förståelse för plattformen och djup inom ditt eget område
* en ung och ambitiös teknikmiljö med god kunskapsdelning

**Humane**

**Harmony**

title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python/React)
description:
**A Different Kind Of Job Description**
 At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job, so what you'll read here looks a little different from other job ads. It starts with why this is a terrible job. Then it explains why it might be the best career move you'll ever make.
   

  

**Why this is a terrible job**
 This is an incredibly high-paced, high-tempo environment. We're making a generational bet to change all of our lives, and generational bets are not comfortable.
   

  

 You will build agents for subjective workflows. Tax law is objective, but what applies under it and how professionals interpret it is full of judgment. You can give two tax professionals the same task and get two different results where both are right. We're building agentic systems that have to reach their level of accuracy, not a level we decided is good enough. From an engineering standpoint, this is the hardest thing most of us have ever built. At times it will feel like hitting your head against the wall.
   

  

 Customers will sometimes get frustrated, because they expect deterministic results from probabilistic systems, and we're managing the expectations of some of the biggest firms in the world, including the Big Four.
   

  

 And the rhythm is real: we get to the office, we work, we go home and spend time with our families, and then many of us get back online to support our customers in US hours. It's tough. It's relentless.
   

  

**Why it might be the best career choice you'll ever make**
 It's addictive to be part of a business when you know you're winning. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, customers are signing up in numbers, and in under two years we've become the market leader in a space with entrenched incumbents and a drastic need for new AI tools. When we come into head-to-heads with competitors, we win every time, because our product is superior. And we stay focused and diligent: we only work with tax firms that have the right expectations, which is why our typical customer is mid-market and enterprise.
   

  

 The industry looks boring from the outside, but the problem is unsolved, and the space has been riddled with products below the mark for decades. When you push through the wall, there's a spark of joy: a customer says "wow, this is phenomenal." That keeps happening.
   

  

 The opportunity here is not only to make a great deal of money. It's to have real impact on our mission: making this profession extraordinary. Nobody became a tax professional for the admin. They got into this work to be creative with tax law, to have fun, and to change the fabric of society. Filed enables them to do exactly that.
   

  

 We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and you can read the story in TechCrunch. Our focus now is to deliver the roadmap and continue to win.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll build the product surface and the platform underneath it:
   

  

* The workflows tax professionals live in every day, from document intake through review to delivery
* Deep integrations with the tax software firms already use, so Filed works where they work
* The pipelines that move documents, data, and returns reliably at scale, through the most intense weeks of tax season


 You'll ship across the stack, own features end to end, and see your work in front of some of the most demanding professional users in the world within days, not quarters.
   

  

**What You'll Be Responsible For**
* Building and maintaining fullstack features across our AI tax prep, planning, and review products
* Owning the UX and backend logic for the workflows tax professionals use every day
* Shipping fast, watching metrics, and deciding what to improve next, without being told
* Learning about LLMs and making them work for our customers to achieve higher accuracy and transparency
* Keeping the codebase clean, typed, and fast as we scale


**Your Hard Skillset**
* Comfortable in TypeScript, React, and Python: you've built complex, data-heavy UIs and backend services before
* Familiar with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud and/or Azure
* Bonus if you've worked in fast-paced startups or regulated industries
* Even bigger bonus if you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it


**Your Soft Skillset**
* Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data
* Empathetic and curious: building for the user, not just for clean code
* Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax
* Detail-oriented but pragmatic: you know when polish matters and when to ship
* You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it


**A championship team**
 We think of ourselves as a sports team. Incredibly high performance, incredibly high standards, and real success to show for it. Being a championship team means working with people who are deeply proud of the work they do and have great fun doing it together.
   

  

 We measure employee happiness constantly, and our eNPS is +60. We don't say that to brag. We say it because a team playing at this tempo only holds together if people genuinely love being on it. Every four months, the whole company comes together for an offsite.
   

  

**What Filed Stands For**
 Not posters. Not corporate language. Real operating standards.
   

  

* No problem is someone else's problem If you see it, it's yours. Bugs, customer confusion, missed expectations, internal friction. We don't pass problems sideways and we don't hide behind roles. You fix the typo even if you didn't write it, jump into a customer issue even if it's not your department, escalate early, and close loops fully. Ownership means you drive resolution, not that you suffer silently or burn out doing everything alone.
* Waiting is not a strategy Momentum is our advantage. We don't wait for perfect information or stall because something is unclear. title: Software Engineer, iOS
description:
**Join us in building a world-class creative platform used by millions of people.**
 Our product, SCRL, is a powerful photo and video editing platform loved by millions of creators worldwide.
   

  

 We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our iOS team and grow into the kind of engineer who can tackle the hardest problems in mobile.
   

  

**About The Role**
 SCRL isn't a typical app. It's a tool people use to create, which means the engineering challenges go far beyond standard iOS development: real-time image and video manipulation, complex multi-touch interactions, advanced layout systems, and performance-sensitive rendering.
   

  

 You'll be joining a team of experienced engineers who care deeply about their craft. You'll ship real features to millions of users, work on problems that stretch your abilities, and learn faster than you would almost anywhere else.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 Build
   

  

* Develop features across SCRL's editing experience, from UI components to underlying logic.
* Work on gesture-driven interactions: touch handling, dragging, resizing, and snapping.
* Contribute to performance improvements where frame rates and responsiveness matter.
* Write clean, correct Swift that holds up as the product evolves.


 Learn & Grow
   

  

* Deepen your understanding of the iOS platform: UIKit, Core Animation, and frameworks like Core Image and AVFoundation.
* Build intuition for coordinate geometry, state management, and how complex editing features fit together.
* Get regular feedback through code reviews, pairing sessions, and direct collaboration with senior engineers.
* Take on increasingly complex problems as your skills and confidence grow.


 Collaborate
   

  

* Work closely with design to bring interactions, animations, and transitions to life.
* Participate in planning sessions and contribute ideas to how features are built.
* Share what you learn and help strengthen the team around you.


 You should have
   

  

* Solid experience in iOS development and Swift.
* Experience building interactive, gesture-driven interfaces.
* Familiarity with UIKit and Core Animation.
* Curiosity about what happens beneath the surface of the frameworks you use.
* A desire to get significantly better at what you do.


 Strong signals
   

  

* Experience working on consumer apps with a large user base.
* Interest in how tools and editors are built.
* A natural curiosity about what happens beneath the surface of the frameworks you use.
* Experience with animation, transitions, or motion in iOS apps.
* You've built something on your own time that you're proud of.


 What we offer
   

  

* The chance to work on genuinely hard, interesting problems every day.
* A product that millions of people use to create, not just another feed or dashboard.
* A team that will push you to grow and give you the support to do it.
* Real ownership and visible impact from day one.
* Great colleagues and office in central Stockholm.
* Competitive compensation and opportunities for professional development.


 We’re a growing team based in central Stockholm, working closely across disciplines to build products people love. We care deeply about craft, collaboration and creating a place where everyone can learn and grow.

**About Matters** 




 Hi! We're Matters, a Stockholm-based company with a global vision. We're currently in stealth mode, building the next generation of banking to make financial well-being and wealth accessible to everyone. Our experienced team of proven entrepreneurs and operators is backed by prominent Swedish angel investors.
 



  





 We're building a company for the long run, prioritizing high standards, low ego, and a strong sense of responsibility. We value individuals who care deeply about the customer, speak their minds, keep their word, and are driven to improve their work, not just complete it. We move quickly, trust our team members, and expect them to use that trust wisely. While we're serious about our mission, we also believe the journey of building it together should be genuinely enjoyable.
 



  





**About the role** 




 We're looking for an iOS Engineer to own the part people actually touch — the native app where someone finds out where they stand with their money. Native Swift, a bar for craft that doesn't move, and the kind of detail work that only shows up when it's missing. This is an on-site position in our Stockholm office.
 



  





**What you'll work on** 



* Build and maintain features across budgeting, transactions, accounts and bank connections, in Swift.
* Make the app right when the network isn't. Core Data, local persistence, and offline behaviour that has to be correct, not nearly correct.
* Design and build the interface itself — type, motion, spacing, the details nobody names and everybody feels. How we make things is the proof of how we think.
* Work with backend and product to ship end to end.



  





**What we're looking for** 



* Solid iOS experience with Swift.
* A good grasp of app architecture and local persistence — Core Data today — and how an app should behave when the network doesn't cooperate.
* An eye for UX and a refusal to ship anything that feels bad to use.
* We're iOS-first today, and that isn't the whole plan. If you've shipped Android or Kotlin, or want to, say so.
* Fintech experience is a plus, not a requirement.
* AI is a default tool here, not an experiment. We expect you to work the same way, with whatever models or tools you're most comfortable with.



  





**Our hiring process** 




 We believe in a transparent and thorough hiring process to ensure a great fit for both you and Matters. Here's what you can expect:
 



  




* **TA Interview:** 
 A conversation with our recruiter about your background, what you're looking for, and what we're building. Ask us anything.



  




* **Team Manager and CEO Interview:** 
 Here we go deeper into the craft. How you structure an iOS app, how you think about local persistence and behaviour when the network doesn't cooperate, and how you make the small interface decisions that add up. You'll also meet our CEO to talk about where we're heading and what you'd want to own in getting there.



  





 We look forward to learning more about you and how you can contribute to our mission at Matters. If you're ready to build something truly impactful, we encourage you to apply!

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
**About Matters** 




 Hi! We're Matters, a Stockholm-based company with a global vision. We're currently in stealth mode, building the next generation of banking to make financial well-being and wealth accessible to everyone. Our experienced team of proven entrepreneurs and operators is backed by prominent Swedish angel investors.
 



  





 We're building a company for the long run, prioritizing high standards, low ego, and a strong sense of responsibility. We value individuals who care deeply about the customer, speak their minds, keep their word, and are driven to improve their work, not just complete it. We move quickly, trust our team members, and expect them to use that trust wisely. While we're serious about our mission, we also believe the journey of building it together should be genuinely enjoyable.
 



  





**About the role** 




 We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to take ownership of the core services that move and make sense of people's money — authentication, transaction sync, and open banking. You'll evolve the backend from what it is today into what a bank actually needs, and you'll help decide what that means. You'll be based in our Stockholm office.
 



  





**What you'll work on** 



* Build and maintain the backend services in TypeScript/Node.js, where reliability is the feature.
* Design and operate Postgres data models and queue-based sync workers that carry complex financial data.
* Integrate and maintain open-banking providers — Plaid, Tink and SaltEdge — along with other third-party APIs.
* Own bank connections and the data and sync pipelines behind them.
* Shape architecture and technical direction as we scale.
* Drive the migration from our legacy Django backend to a modern Node stack on Render.



  





**What we're looking for** 



* Strong backend experience. We run on Node.js, and we care that you know the runtime, not just the syntax — much less which languages you got there in.
* A solid grasp of relational databases and API design.
* Fintech, payments, or open-banking experience is a strong plus.
* Judgement about what to build and what to leave alone. We make this for the person whose money it is.
* AI is a default tool here, not an experiment. We expect you to work the same way, with whatever models or tools you're most comfortable with.



  





**Our hiring process** 




 We believe in a transparent and thorough hiring process to ensure a great fit for both you and Matters. Here's what you can expect:
 



  




* **TA Interview** 
 : A conversation with our recruiter about your background, what you're looking for, and what we're building. Ask us anything.



  




* **Team Manager and CEO Interview** 
 : Here we go deeper into the craft. How you design services and data models, how you reason about reliability, sync and third-party integrations, and the judgement behind what you choose not to build. You'll also meet our CEO to talk about where we're heading and what you'd want to own in getting there.



  





 We look forward to learning more about you and how you can contribute to our mission at Matters. If you're ready to build something truly impactful, we encourage you to apply!

title: Senior systemutvecklare Java, Stockholm
description:
**Jobbeskrivning**
 Vill du utveckla system som bidrar till ett mer effektivt och fungerande samhälle? Hos oss arbetar du med lösningar inom offentlig sektor, telekom och energi där kvalitet och stabilitet är avgörande.
   

  

 Som
 **senior Javautvecklare** 
 blir du en del av våra agila teamleveranser och arbetar nära både kund och kollegor i långsiktiga uppdrag. Rollen kombinerar utveckling med tekniskt ansvar där du är delaktig genom hela utvecklingsprocessen, från design och implementation till vidareutveckling av befintliga lösningar.
   

  

 Du arbetar i en modern Java miljö med Spring Boot och mikrotjänstarkitektur. Frontend sker i React, Angular eller Vue och vi använder Kubernetes, Git, Maven eller Gradle samt testning med JUnit och Mockito. Våra leveranser bedrivs agilt med etablerade CI/CD-flöden och ett starkt fokus på samarbete, kvalitet och kunskapsdelning. Läs mer här.
   

  

**Det här erbjuder Sopra Steria dig**
 Hos oss kombinerar du stabiliteten i ett etablerat bolag med en kultur präglad av samarbete, kunskapsdelning och hög teknisk kompetens. Du arbetar i varierande uppdrag tillsammans med erfarna kollegor och får möjlighet att utvecklas vidare inom både teknik och arkitektur.
   

  

**Några av våra förmåner**
* 5 000 kr i friskvårdsbidrag samt hälsostöd
* 30 dagars semester samt två extra lediga dagar per år
* Certifieringsbonus och kompetensutveckling
* Föräldralön, tjänstepension och försäkringar
* Bidrag till hemmakontor och arbetsutrustning


**Det här kommer du att göra**
* Utveckla och vidareutveckla Java lösningar i komplexa uppdrag
* Vara delaktig i tekniska beslut, design och implementation
* Arbeta nära kund och team i agila leveranser
* Bidra till kvalitet, säkerhet och hållbara lösningar
* Dela kunskap och stötta kollegor i tekniska frågor


**Vi söker dig som har**
* Minst 8 års erfarenhet av Javautveckling
* Erfarenhet av konsultrollen
* Goda kunskaper i Java och Spring Boot
* Erfarenhet av moderna webbramverk i JavaScript eller TypeScript, gärna React eller Angular
* Erfarenhet av unit och integrationstestning, exempelvis JUnit eller Mockito
* Vana av Git samt byggverktyg som Maven eller Gradle
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av molnplattformar
* Erfarenhet av container orkestrering
* Erfarenhet från uppdrag inom offentlig sektor, telekom eller energi


**Rekryteringsprocessen**
 I rollen ställs höga krav på både kompetens och säkerhetsmedvetenhet. Inför en eventuell anställning genomför vi bakgrundskontroll och vid intervju behöver du kunna uppvisa giltig legitimation.
   

  

 📩 Har du frågor om rollen? Kontakta gärna Clara Bozzi på clara.bozzi@soprasteria.com.

title: Software Engineer, Platform (Developer Experience)
description:
**TL;DR** 
 We are seeking a Platform Engineer to enhance and scale Lovable's developer experience. In this role, you will be responsible for critical components of our stack, ensuring our engineering workflows are faster, smoother, and more
 **Lovable** 
 .
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* You have strong programming skills and a track record of improving developer velocity and system reliability.
* 7+ years of experience working in a platform team supporting developer experience (o11y, CI/CD, application frameworks, productivity tooling, etc).
* You’ve written code and tools to support growing engineering orgs in scale-ups.
* You have experience with Docker, Kubernetes and modern infrastructure practices.
* You’re a problem-solver who thrives on challenges and ships high-leverage systems fast.
* You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and solving problems as they arise.
* You care about security, stability, and speed and know when to make trade-offs between them.
* You’re based in Stockholm or ready to relocate - this is an on-site, 5-days-a-week role.


**What You’ll Do**
**In one sentence:** 
 Own and scale the developer experience at Lovable, making our engineering teams the most productive in the world.
   

  

* Bring order and structure to our code base.
* Integrate or build application frameworks to support a growing engineering organization and code footprint
* Own and develop our observability stack, from code instrumentation through ingestion to presentation.
* Integrating tools for AI driven development.
* Identify and drive reliability improvement efforts across all engineering teams.


**Our tech stack**
 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love. Lovable platform engineers are capable of working across the whole stack. Examples of tech in our stack include:
   

  

* Frontend: React and Typescript.
* Backend: Golang and Rust.
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS.
* Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery.
* DevOps Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, OTEL, Grafana, kubernetes, terraform.
* Local Tooling: Nix, DevEnv.


 And always on the lookout for what's next!
   

  

**About Your Application**
* Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join
* We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal

title: Senior Frontend Lead Engineer
description:
**DigitalRoute is the company behind how the digital world gets paid.** 
 For over 25 years, we've turned massive, complex usage data into trusted, finance-grade information that enterprises rely on to bill, price, and grow. Today, more than 400 companies across SaaS, AI, cloud, media, and telecom run their revenue-critical data through our platform with precision to the cent and zero downtime.
 



  





 And the timing couldn't be better. The entire digital economy is moving away from static subscriptions toward usage- and outcome-based pricing over 75% of new digital products will price this way by 2028. That shift makes what we do essential infrastructure for every business that wants to compete. Our customers reach market 2x faster, grow 4x quicker, and cut revenue leakage by more than half. This is a company where your work has real impact and we're just getting started.
 



  





 We’re now rebuilding our Usage Engine platform. It’s a ground-up, Kubernetes-native, streaming-first data mediation engine with a completely new user experience.
 



 The frontend is central to the product. It’s a Svelte single-page application where engineers design, inspect, and debug pipelines that process billions of usage records every day. Think visual workflow editor, keyboard-first interactions, dense tables, deep links everywhere, and a product that needs to feel more like a desktop engineering tool than a web form.
 



  





 As Senior Frontend Lead Engineer, you’ll own the application, its architecture, its standards, and how it grows. This is a rare greenfield rewrite where the frontend is treated as a core part of the platform.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Lead the design and build of a demanding web application: a graph-based workflow editor with automatic layout using d3 and ELK, embedded code editing with CodeMirror 6, custom language support, diff and merge views, dense data tables, and operational views built for speed.
* Own the frontend architecture and technical direction for a Svelte 5, SvelteKit, TypeScript SPA built with Vite. That includes component structure, state and reactivity patterns, rendering performance, accessibility, and the engineering standards the team works by.
* Connect deeply with the platform’s REST APIs, served by a Vert.x backend, OIDC-based authentication, and a GitOps-native configuration model where every artifact edited in the UI is a version-controlled file, and merging to main deploys it.
* Shape how AI-assisted features show up in the product. The platform includes pipeline copilots, anomaly detection, and self-healing pipelines. The frontend is where users actually meet those features, so the interaction design matters.
* Own quality with the team. We use Vitest and Testing Library for unit and component tests, Playwright for end-to-end tests, svelte-check for type safety, and CI gates that block code that doesn’t meet the bar.
* Work closely with PMs, product owners, UX, backend teams, and the CTO office. The users are highly technical, so part of the job is turning their needs into clear frontend decisions.
* Guide the team through design discussions, hands-on code review, and strong pull request habits. We use GitHub, CI gates, and CODEOWNERS.
* Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot as part of your workflow, and help the team use them well.
* Stay close to the Svelte ecosystem and the wider frontend field, bringing in tools and patterns only when they genuinely help.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Experience as a frontend architect or lead frontend engineer on complex, data-heavy applications. Developer tools, IDEs, visual editors, monitoring products, observability tools, or similar products are the right kind of background. Content-heavy websites are less relevant here.
* Deep hands-on experience with TypeScript and modern component frameworks. Strong Svelte experience is a big plus, especially Svelte 5 and runes-based reactivity. If you come from React or Vue and want to go deep on Svelte, we’d still like to talk.
* Experience building interactive canvas or graph-based interfaces. Dragging, zooming, selection, automatic layout, large datasets, frequent updates — you know where these interfaces get hard, and how to keep them fast.
* Comfort with embedded editor tooling such as CodeMirror or similar tools, including syntax highlighting, linting, autocomplete, and diff or merge views.
* Strong knowledge of the modern frontend toolchain: Vite, npm, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, and shipping SPAs for SaaS or Kubernetes-deployed products.
* A strong testing mindset. Vitest unit coverage and Playwright end-to-end tests are part of your normal definition of done.
* Hands-on development skills. You still write code, and you can demonstrate, build, review, and improve the application yourself.
* Practical experience with AI coding assistants in professional development, plus curiosity about where they can genuinely improve frontend engineering.
* Clear communication, strong teamwork, and comfort collaborating across teams, disciplines, and time zones.
* Bonus: experience with OIDC or OAuth flows, gRPC or Protobuf-backed systems, enterprise or telecom-grade software, or LLM-backed product features.



  





**Why this role** 




 You’ll join a focused Stockholm and Gothenburg-based team rebuilding the heart of a proven product for the next decade. This is a clean-room rewrite, guided by real production workloads and clear engineering standards. The frontend is not a layer on top. It is one of the main ways users understand, trust, and operate the platform. The team is small enough that your decisions will shape the product. The company is established enough that what you build will be used by serious enterprise customers in production.
 



  





 We follow a continuous selection process, and the position may be filled before the last application date.
 



  





 DigitalRoute is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse environment, and we actively encourage qualified candidates of all genders, sexual orientations, ethnicities, disabilities, and ages to apply. Join our global and diverse company, where our differences are our strengths.

title: IT-Specialist
description:
*Vill du utveckla säkra och moderna lösningar som gör konkret skillnad för våra motorförsäkringskunder? Som IT‑specialist/systemutvecklare inom Motorområdet får du arbeta med .NET och moderna webbramverk i ett agilt team där samarbete, kvalitet och affärsnytta står i fokus. Du deltar i hela utvecklingsprocessen – från design och utveckling till testning, driftsättning och förvaltning – och är med och säkerställer robusta, säkra och affärsnyttiga IT‑lösningar.*
**Om jobbet**
 Vi söker en systemutvecklare med fokus på .NET inom Motorområdet. Rollen innebär deltagande i hela utvecklingsprocessen: design, utveckling, testning, driftsättning och förvaltning av säkra och moderna applikationer/integrationer, både webb och backend. Huvudansvar inkluderar att säkerställa robusta, säkra och affärsnyttiga IT‑lösningar samt bidra till teamets gemensamma leveranser.
   

  

 Du ingår i ett systemteam om cirka 6–10 personer inom Motorområdet. Teamet består av utvecklare, testare, Scrum Master och produktägare. Närmaste samarbeten sker inom teamet, men du har även kontaktytor mot affär, IT‑drift och andra specialistteam. Arbetssättet är agilt med stort fokus på samarbete, gemensamma mål och ständig kunskapsdelning. Rollen rapporterar till närmaste chef och innebär löpande kontakter med produktägare, verksamhet, IT‑stöd och externa partners beroende på projekt och process.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer vara bland annat:
   

  

* Utveckla, underhålla och optimera applikationer i .NET.
* Vidareutveckla och förvalta befintliga system (webb och backend).
* Arbeta med Blazor, Angular, SQL Server, CI/CD och OpenShift.
* Övervaka och förbättra system med Splunk, Dynatrace och ServiceNow.
* Säkerställa säker kod och hög kvalitet med bland annat Checkmarx.
* Delta i kravarbete samt samarbeta med produktägare och andra intressenter.
* Hantera incidenter, felsöka samt dokumentera.
* Föreslå och implementera process- och teknikförbättringar.
* På sikt: ta utökat ansvar inom arkitektur, DevOps eller systemintegrationer.


 Följande kommer göra dig framgångsrik i denna tjänst:
   

  

* Akademisk examen inom datateknik, systemvetenskap eller motsvarande.
* 2–5 års erfarenhet av systemutveckling.
* Gedigen kompetens inom .NET‑utveckling (C#).
* Erfarenhet av webbteknologier såsom Blazor och Angular.
* Kännedom om databaser och integrationer, gärna SQL Server.
* Erfarenhet av versionshantering med Git.
* Erfarenhet av CI/CD och deployment pipelines är ett plus.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.


 Meriterande är även om du har:
   

  

* Certifiering inom .NET eller Guidewire.
* Erfarenhet av agila ramverk/certifiering (t.ex. SAFe).
* Erfarenhet av Guidewire.
* Erfarenhet av monitoring/loggning (Splunk, Dynatrace, ServiceNow).
* Erfarenhet av testautomatisering och säker kodgranskning (Checkmarx).


 Som person är du en lagspelare som bidrar till gott samarbete och delar kunskap med teamet. Du är analytisk och problemlösande, med förmåga att identifiera och lösa tekniska problem snabbt och effektivt. Du trivs i ett agilt sammanhang, tar ansvar för dina leveranser och uppskattar en miljö där man kontinuerligt förbättrar både teknik och arbetssätt.
   

  

**Kontaktpersoner**
 Rekryterande chef: axel.ornevall@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Forena: susanne.Hirsch2@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen: maria.eriksson@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

*Låter det spännande? Då vill vi veta mer om dig! Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi arbetar löpande med denna rekrytering och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag.*
 Länsförsäkringar AB är en inkluderande arbetsplats där mod, möjligheter och engagemang står i centrum. Vi erbjuder ett hållbart arbetsliv med flexibla villkor och satsar på att alla medarbetare ska kunna växa och trivas, oavsett bakgrund.
   

  

 Affärsenhet Sak är länsförsäkringsgruppens drivkraft inom sakförsäkring. Vi utvecklar nya affärer, skapar smarta försäkringslösningar och ser till att kunderna alltid har trygghet i vardagen. Vi står bakom gemensamma koncept, digital försäljning och kundkommunikation – och vi kompletterar bolagens erbjudanden med specialprodukter som gör skillnad.
   

  

 Hos oss får du vara med och forma framtidens försäkring – där innovation möter samhällsnytta.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Build something monumental for Healthcare!**
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
   

  

 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re looking for an exceptional Senior AI Engineer to join us in building the future of healthcare in Europe.
   

  

 This is not a traditional ML role. We’re looking for someone who has spent the last few years deeply immersed in building real-world, LLM-native products - someone who has moved beyond prototypes and understands what it takes to ship fast, reliable, production-grade AI systems that users depend on every day.
   

  

 Today, our AI products are already used daily by thousands of healthcare professionals across Europe. Our AI scribe is live in production at significant scale, and we’re now expanding far beyond documentation into a broader suite of AI-native workflows and products across the healthcare experience.
   

  

 You’ll join a small, highly ambitious team building some of the most advanced applied AI systems in European healthcare. We believe AI will fundamentally reshape healthcare over the coming decade, and we’re building products that meaningfully improve how care is delivered at scale.
   

  

 This role comes with substantial ownership, not only over technical execution, but also over shaping new AI initiatives, product directions, and how AI gets deployed across the company.
   

  

 We’re still early enough that the right person will have enormous impact on both the product and the organization, while working alongside an unusually strong team of engineers, builders, and operators. This role is ideal for someone currently building AI-heavy products at a startup or fast-moving tech company, and who wants to work even closer to the frontier of applied AI.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Build and scale deeply integrated LLM-powered product experiences used daily by healthcare professionals across Europe
* Lead new AI initiatives from concept to production, helping define both technical direction and product strategy
* Design robust systems around prompting, orchestration, evaluation, retrieval, agents, speech, and model infrastructure
* Own projects end-to-end - from early product thinking and architecture decisions to deployment and iteration in production
* Work closely with product, design, and engineering to create AI experiences that feel magical while remaining reliable and practical
* Continuously evaluate and integrate new models, tooling, and infrastructure as the ecosystem evolves
* Improve performance, latency, reliability, and cost-efficiency across our AI stack
* Help shape how we work with AI across the company as we continue scaling our platform and team


 What You Bring
   

  

* 5+ years of engineering experience, with at least 2–4 years spent primarily building and shipping LLM-powered products
* Strong hands-on experience applying modern LLMs in production environments - not just experimentation or research
* Experience building agentic workflows or complex multi-step LLM systems
* Experience leading technical initiatives or owning major AI product areas with high autonomy
* Experience working with evaluation pipelines, model monitoring, or AI reliability systems
* A strong product mindset and intuition for building AI experiences that create real user value
* Experience operating in fast-moving startup environments with high ownership and ambiguity
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and ability to build high-quality systems end-to-end
* Experience with technologies such as Python, TypeScript, React, Kubernetes, or similar modern tooling
* Deep curiosity about the rapidly evolving AI landscape, and excitement to stay at the frontier of applied AI
* collaborative, low-ego approach and desire to work with exceptionally talented teammates


 Bonus Points
   

  

* Experience with speech-to-text, voice AI, or multimodal models
* Experience in healthcare or other regulated industries
* Experience with fine-tuning and training LLMs


 Location
   

  

 We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This role is based in our vibrant HQ in the Epicenter building in the heart of Stockholm where you will work primarily from our office to collaborate, connect, and build our culture.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.
   

  

 Our interview process consists of 4 stages:
   

  

* Screening interview with Talent Acquisition
* Technical interviews with some of our Engineering team
* System Design Interview at our office - Join us in the Stockholm office for a lunch and a Product focused System Design interview to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.
* Follow-up interview with our CTO & Co-Founder


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary & company stock options
* 30 days/year of paid vacation
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag) plus an additional 6,000 SEK yearly to spend on other health related initiatives
* Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents
* Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy
* Mental health support through our partner Mindler
* Pension program
* Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)
* An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare
* Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.


*We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.*
**Culture at Tandem**
 At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.
   

  

 Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.
   

  

 Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.
   

  

 We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.
   

  

*Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.*

title: Cloud Developer - Is DevEx your "product" of choice?
description:
Playground Tech

 Cloud Developer - Is DevEx your "product" of choice?
   

  

 The Playgorund Pitch
   

  

 The world of cloud is changing. Fast. And we want you, who thrive in bleeding edge, to transform the Cloud space with us!
   

  

 This is why we have created a whole new genre of devs who'll bring us to the next level and beyond.
   

  

 We want to grow with a low-ego, collaborative and backend-focused cloud developer who acts as a force multiplier for the engineering team. The connective "spider in the web" (sorry) that makes everyone else ship faster, more safely, and more consistently. Rather than adding to a product backlog, you will build the internal tooling, shared services, and paved roads the rest of the team builds on, smooths the path from code to production, and brings engineering discipline to teams now moving fast with AI-assisted development.
   

  

 Sounds like the role you've been searching for?
   

  

**Your Role**
 This is a developer-productivity role at heart. On assignment, the Cloud Developer is the person who makes a client's engineering team faster and more effective: building the internal services, libraries, and tooling the rest of the team relies on, and the paved roads that make shipping fast, safe, and repeatable. They are the connective tissue across product code, tooling, and infrastructure. Less the person shipping the next feature, more the person who makes shipping anything easier for everyone else.
   

  

 The cloud is the substrate they work in; developer experience is the product. The forward-looking angle is where the need is coming from. Client engineering teams are now moving fast with AI coding tools, and that speed only pays off if the surrounding machinery keeps up, the guardrails and tooling, that let a team ship AI-assisted code safely and consistently. This role is that someone: raising the bar on how an organisation builds, now that much of the building is AI-accelerated.
   

  

 What this role is - and is not
   

  

**What This Role Is**
* Building the internal services, libraries, and developer tooling. Primarily in Go, that the rest of a client's engineers build on
* Smoothing the path from code to production: CI/CD, build and release tooling, and the paved roads that make shipping fast, safe, and consistent
* Reducing friction and toil across the engineering workflow, doing the connective work that will elevate a whole team's output
* Bringing discipline to AI-accelerated development: the guardrails, patterns, harnesses, and tooling that let a team move fast with AI without shipping a mess


**What This Role Is Not**
* Not a "vanilla" product developer. This isn't about churning out business logic and enduser features; the value is in multiplying a team's output, not adding to its backlog
* Not a frontend, data-engineering, or ML/Data Science career path. This person integrates and consumes AI services, they don't build data pipelines or train models as their craft


 Who are you?
   

  

 Your temperament matters as much as your stack and ambitions. You'll join a team with traits that are strikingly consistent: a curious, low-ego builder who takes real ownership of quality and reliability, communicates clearly, and is happiest making both the work and the people around them better.
   

  

 Concretely, that means someone collaborative and unterritorial — focused on lifting the team around them rather than guarding turf — and pragmatic and outcome-oriented, bridging technical work and business goals and comfortable with product and stakeholders
   

  

 Skils & Background
   

  

* 5+ years as a developer/SW engineer/programmer/cloud engineer, who enjoys building for builders
* Go (Golang) is your home turf + you have depth and feel comfortable in at least one other, modern, language like, C#, Python, Java, or Typescript
* AWS, Azure, or GCP — any one, or a combination, heck even onpremises counts
* Any infrastructure-as-code — Pulumi or Terraform are preferred
* Demonstrable interest in AI is required, hands-on experience a plus\*
* Managed or self-managed Kubernetes (Bonus, not a requirement)
* Fluency in Swedish and English, as most of our collaborations and client projects are conducted in Swedish
* Interest in AI is a requirement for this role; hands-on AI experience is a strong plus but not a prerequisite. The bar, though, is evidenced curiosity rather than a bare claim of interest — we want someone who can actually show something.


 Required: genuine, demonstrable engagement with AI tooling. A side project, real use of AI coding assistants, or a considered first-hand opinion formed from building with them.
   

  

 A strong plus: hands-on experience with AI/LLM infrastructure and frameworks: AWS Bedrock / AgentCore, Vertex AI, agentic frameworks, Claude Code, and similar.
   

  

 Let's Play!
   

  

 Applying to us is a breeze!
   

  

* Upload your resumé or use your Linkedin profile
* Answer the choice-questions (no "please-rewrite-your-resume" nonsense, promise)
* Feel free to include links to your portfolio, GitHub or similar if you have stuff you're proud of that you want to share with us


**Important Notes**
* Playground Group does not provide visa sponsorship or relocation support
* Applicants must already have a permanent and independent right to work in Sweden
* As part of the final stage of the recruitment process, a background check conducted by a third party will be carried out.


 Welcome to Playground!
   

  

 At Playground, you work on real, complex assignments for well-established and ambitious clients, not bench projects or short-lived experiments. Our teams are trusted with production systems, platforms, and data that actually matter. Here growth comes from ownership, curiosity, and doing the work properly. You’re trusted to think, contribute, and keep getting better, one meaningful step at a time.
   

  

 Playground brings together specialized domains under one umbrella, with a shared culture and way of working, and easy access to broad technical expertise when it helps move the work forward.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Sweden
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Sales
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 We are Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.
   

  

 Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
   

  

 The Builder Experience
   

  

* AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.
* Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.
* Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.
* Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.


 What You'll Actually Be Building
   

  

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.


 You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If…
   

  

* You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.
* You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.


 Nice-to-Haves
   

  

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.
