title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Avalanche Studios Group is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data and Insights team!
   

  

 This role is responsible for designing, developing and maintaining scalable data pipelines and state-of-the-art data processing technologies. You will play a key role in our Data Engineering team, ensuring that our data infrastructure is reliable, performant, and successfully tied to delivering better data systems for our games and publishing activities. This role requires a deep understanding of data engineering methodologies/frameworks in a big-data environment ; coupled to a strong collaborative spirit.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Develop and implement processes to extract, clean, and transform data from various sources to ensure it is ready for modelling/consumption.
* Collaborate with analytics engineers, data scientists/analysts and product stakeholders to understand their data needs and provide them with reliable data solutions ; capturing a complete ecosystem view of in- and out-of-game user behaviors.
* Architect and implement robust, maintainable, and high-performance ETL/ELT pipelines and data systems ; ensuring accuracy, compliance, scalability, and long-term usability.
* Create and maintain comprehensive data documentation, including data dictionaries, schemas, and metadata. Ensure that data definitions are consistent and easily accessible to all stakeholders.
* Monitor data pipelines and systems to ensure high availability and performance alongside our analytics engineer ; implement automated data quality checks, validation processes and alerts ensuring the accuracy and reliability of data.
* Write efficient, maintainable, and scalable code using best practices. Conduct code and SQL reviews and provide feedback to ensure high standards of code quality within the team.
* Stay updated with the latest trends, technologies, frameworks and best practices in data engineering / analytics / AI and share knowledge with the team.


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field ; with 8+ years experience in data engineering or a related field.
* Strong proficiency in big-data technologies and languages, such as Python, Spark, Scala, SQL, and Java.Experience with ETL/ELT processes and tools (e.g. Apache Airflow, Talend, DBT… DBT being a big plus).
* Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure… GCP being a big plus) ; and experience with “Infrastructure as Code” process (e.g. Terraform).
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail ; coupled with strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
* Passion for gaming and a deep understanding of the gaming industry is a plus!


 Note: Research shows under-represented groups in the industry might not apply to a job if they don’t check off every requirement. At Avalanche, we’re more about your drive to learn and interest in tackling challenges than what’s on your resume! So don’t stress if you don’t tick every box— shoot us your application anyway! Diverse opinions and different experiences are what make our teams so great, not itemized lists of qualifications.
   

  

**The Stockholm location**
 Our Stockholm office is situated in Södermalm, the beating heart of the city’s game industry. It’s a physical representation of our games – the lush vegetation of Just Cause and theHunter: Call of the Wild meets corroded metal straight out of Mad Max. Our hybrid model requires you to be in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays to foster collaboration and creativity.
   

  

**Our values**
 At Avalanche Studios Group, we create worlds beyond limits. But that’s not exclusive to our games, so we’re committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. All Avalanchers have a shared responsibility to create an open work environment where everyone is treated equally and respectfully. Being part of our world is not contingent on your heritage, your gender, or sexual orientation. It’s all about your passion and creativity.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 To apply for this position, please register below and provide your CV in English. We review applications continuously. All further studio-related information is provided under a non-disclosure agreement.
   

  

 At Avalanche Studios Group we're always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our passionate team, but please note that relocation assistance is not available for this role.

title: Applied AI Analyst
description:
We want to create a different kind of banking and shopping experience. Northmill was founded in 2006 and the main office is in Stockholm and Engineering Center site located in Poland.
 



  





 Grab this opportunity to be a part of us and our journey!
 



  





**The scope of your role:** 




 As a Senior Applied AI Analyst, you will work across business departments and product engineering teams to discover, analyse and validate high-value opportunities for process automation.
 



 This role combines business and process analysis with hands-on AI prototyping and a solid understanding of software engineering. You will work directly with process owners and operational teams to understand how work is performed today, identify bottlenecks and repetitive activities, assess the potential value of improvements, and turn the most promising opportunities into testable AI-enabled solutions.
 



 You will actively search for opportunities rather than wait for predefined requirements. Once an idea is validated, you will work with Product Engineers and the AI Platform team to shape the production approach and transfer ownership to the relevant product team.
 



  





**You will be responsible for:** 



* Working with process owners and business teams to understand and map existing processes
* Identifying bottlenecks, manual work and opportunities for AI-assisted or automated workflows
* Translating business problems into clear use cases, requirements and testable hypotheses
* Assessing business value, feasibility, data readiness, operational risk and required controls
* Building and validating lightweight prototypes, independently or together with engineering teams
* Defining success metrics, acceptance criteria and evaluation scenarios
* Recommending whether a process should be assisted, partially automated or fully automated
* Supporting Product Engineers in moving validated solutions toward production
* Embedding with product teams when needed to support implementation, adoption and knowledge transfer
* Sharing reusable patterns and providing feedback to the AI Platform Team



  





**You will work with:** 



* Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Quick and other foundation-model platforms
* Agentic workflows and tool-based integrations
* Company data, documents and internal systems
* REST APIs and event-driven integrations
* .NET, C# and TypeScript
* Modern AI development and prototyping tools such as Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot



  





**Required qualifications:** 



* 5+ years of commercial experience in software engineering, business analysis, process automation, AI engineering or a related role
* Strong ability to analyse, map and improve business processes
* Experience working directly with process owners, operational teams and business stakeholders
* Ability to turn unclear business problems into structured use cases, requirements and experiments
* Hands-on experience building or contributing to AI-enabled prototypes or automation workflows
* Strong product mindset and focus on measurable business outcomes
* Solid understanding of software engineering, APIs and system integrations
* Understanding of AI security, privacy and operational risks



  





**Preferred qualifications:** 



* Experience with Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Quick or similar services
* Experience with process mining, workflow engines or business-process redesign
* Experience with agent tools, MCP or AI-enabled integrations
* Experience with document extraction, classification or knowledge-based AI solutions
* Experience supporting a solution from discovery through production handover
* Experience in banking, fintech or another regulated industry



  





**About you?** 




 You’re a creative and curious person with a genuine passion for software development. Like us, you love learning, staying up to date with the latest tech trends, and writing clean, high-quality code.
 



 You’re comfortable sharing your thoughts, raising problems early, and contributing to thoughtful solutions. You thrive in a team environment and have experience working in an Agile setup.
 



 As we’re a multicultural team, strong proficiency in English is required. Fluency in Swedish will be a great asset.
 



  





**We offer:** 



* A fantastic office in a prime Stockholm location with great spaces and views.
* An independent role with the opportunity to make a real impact.
* Great opportunities for professional development.
* Support for sporting activities (a SEK 5,000 wellness allowance).
* Life insurance.
* Breakfast and fruit in the office every day, plus a Friday afternoon coffee break.
* Regular after-work get-togethers on Fridays and celebrations of successes in the office.



  





**About Northmill Bank** 




 A Swedish bank with the heart in the technique. 2.500 merchants. 600.000 end users.
 



 over 300 employees in 3 different countries, including Engineering Center hiring c.a. 90 experienced engineers. The goal? To improve financial life by being digital, yet personal.
 



**Apply today and be a part of Northmill!**

title: Production Assistant
description:
**About The Role**
 At Happy Socks, our product is our pride and joy. We design, develop, test, learn, and produce unmistakably on-brand products to a high standard. We have a lean team of knowledgeable, motivated experts, and we thrive in a high-energy, fast-paced environment where agility, ownership, and adaptability is everything. As our Production Assistant, you are the vital administrative engine and "connective tissue" bridging our Product Developers (PD), Buyers, Design, Logistics, and Finance teams.
   

  

 This role is built for someone with incredible attention to detail, a passion for retail and product creation, and a relentless "get-it-done" attitude. While senior team members manage commercial negotiations and execution, you will be responsible for keeping the engine running smoothly-tracking milestones, keeping master data pristine, monitoring payment ready dates, and ensuring shipment visibility.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Operational & Administrative Support (Connecting the Dots)
* Act as the primary administrative support for Product Developers and Buyers, assisting them across the full product lifecycle.
* Maintain and update master data across PLM (e.g., Delogue) and ERP systems (e.g., Business Central) to ensure complete data accuracy across all styles, purchase orders, and SKUs.
* Organize, track, and log Sample Requests (Proto, SMS/Salesman Samples, Photo Samples, and Production Samples), handling physical sample administration and dispatch.
* Support with monthly order placements as needed
* . Financial Tracking & Payment Oversight
* Verify and match initial supplier invoices against purchase orders, delivery notes, and agreed payment schedules.
* Track and flag upcoming invoice payment dates to senior team members and Finance to ensure timely payments and prevent release holds at origin.


**What We Are Looking For (Skills & Mindset)**
* Obsessive Attention to Detail: You love structured data, clear spreadsheets, and double-checking details. You get a sense of satisfaction from pristine administrative records.
* Startup Mindset & Energy: High energy, self-motivated, proactive, and thrives in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving workplace where no two days are the same.
* Passionate about Product & Retail: A genuine interest in operations, consumer goods, and how products go from design sketch to retail shelf.
* Strong Communicator & Connector: You naturally bridge gaps between different departments (PD, Buying, Logistics, Finance) and keep everyone aligned.
* Problem Solver: You spot discrepancies early, ask questions, and raise flags proactively.


**Requirements & Qualifications**
* Experience: 1–2 years in an administrative, coordination, or assistant role within retail, production, buying, supply chain, or e-commerce (or a recent graduate with relevant internships/education in Textile, Retail Management, or Supply Chain), and / or university degree in Textiles / Buying.
* English speaking required (Swedish or Turkish language is a plus)
* Retail experience in head office is a plus

title: Agentic Engineering Lead Developer
description:
**Jobbeskrivning**
***Vill du leda nästa steg i hur AI förändrar modern systemutveckling?***
 På Sopra Steria hjälper vi några av Nordens mest betydelsefulla verksamheter att utveckla digitala lösningar som skapar verkligt värde. Nu stärker vi vår satsning inom Agentic Engineering och söker dig som vill forma hur AI-agenter och nya arbetssätt blir en naturlig del av modern systemutveckling.
   

  

 Som Agentic Engineering Lead kombinerar du teknisk förståelse med förmågan att designa, införa och skala agentiska arbetssätt. Du hjälper kunder att gå från traditionell utveckling till AI-förstärkta leveransmodeller där agenter, automatisering och mänsklig expertis samverkar för att skapa mätbart värde.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Du driver införandet av agentiska lösningar och arbetssätt i komplexa kundmiljöer. Rollen handlar om att förstå kundens utvecklingsprocesser, identifiera var AI-agenter kan skapa störst effekt och säkerställa att lösningarna blir säkra, skalbara och förankrade i verksamhetens mål.
   

  

**Exempel på ansvarsområden:**
* Designa och etablera agentiska arbetsflöden där AI-agenter blir en naturlig del av kundens leveransmodell
* Omsätta verksamhetsbehov till agentarkitekturer, instruktioner, verktygskopplingar och tydliga kvalitetsramar
* Utforska, konfigurera och vidareutveckla lösningar med exempelvis LLM:er, agentramverk, API:er, MCP och utvecklingsplattformar
* Säkerställa governance, spårbarhet, säkerhet och kvalitet i AI-stödda arbetsflöden och kodnära processer
* Leda förändringsarbete och hjälpa kunder att bygga förmåga, mognad och arbetssätt för Agentic Engineering


**Vem är du?**
 Vi söker dig som rör dig naturligt mellan teknik, verksamhet och förändring. Du behöver förstå modern mjukvaruutveckling på djupet, men din främsta styrka är att se hur AI-agenter, verktyg och nya arbetssätt kan förändra hur team tänker, bygger, testar och levererar.
   

  

**Vi tror att du har med dig:**
* Gedigen förståelse för modern systemutveckling, arkitektur och mjukvaruleverans
* Praktisk erfarenhet av AI-drivna utvecklingsverktyg, agentramverk eller liknande lösningar
* Förmåga att designa arbetssätt där AI-agenter, automatisering och utvecklingsteam samverkar effektivt
* God förståelse för kvalitet, säkerhet, test, CI/CD och governance i AI-stödda leveranser
* Vana att arbeta med plattformar som Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, GitLab eller motsvarande
* Förmåga att kommunicera obehindrat på svenska och engelska
* Erfarenhet av konsultrollen och att driva dialog med kunder, beslutsfattare och tekniska team


**Meriterande**
 Det är extra intressant om du har erfarenhet av:
   

  

* Att bygga egna AI-assistenter, agentlösningar eller MCP-servrar
* Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud
* Säkerhet, compliance och AI-governance
* Lokala LLM:er och smart modell-routing


**Därför Sopra Steria**
 Hos oss får du vara med och bygga ett område som påverkar hur stora organisationer utvecklar, organiserar och skalar AI-stödda leveranser framåt. Du får arbeta i spännande kunduppdrag hos några av Sveriges ledande organisationer, samtidigt som du är med och utvecklar Sopra Sterias satsning inom Agentic Engineering. Här blir du en del av ett starkt nätverk av tekniska specialister, arkitekter och rådgivare i en kultur präglad av samarbete, entreprenörskap och kunskapsdelning. Vi erbjuder också konkurrenskraftiga villkor och attraktiva förmåner.
   

  

 Vill du leda nästa steg inom AI-driven systemutveckling? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig.

title: Pattern Maker
description:
**Company:** 
 Mandaley AB (50% between each brand Malina and Soft Goat)
 



**Job Description** 
 : Pattern Maker
 



 W
 **orking hours** 
 : Full time
 
  
 
 (100%)
 



**Reports to:** 
 Production Director’s for Malina and Soft Goat
 



**Location** 
 : Birger Jarlsgatan 58, 11429 Stockholm
 



**Application:** 
  We review applications on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as possible by sending your CV, and cover letter to both josephine.norris@softgoat.com & lina.adelow@bymalina.com (send in the same email)
 



  





 Mandaley is looking for a Pattern Maker to work across both brands, Malina and Soft Goat. As a candidate, you must have a wide knowledge and experience in all product categories. In this role, you will lead and elevate the product fit and quality across both assortments, whilst driving collection consistency and innovation. 
 



  





**Areas of responsibility** 




  




* Manage the product lifecycle from initial concept through sampling, fittings and to final sample.
* Ownership of category, and decision-making as required
* Owns the Product Fit for all categories and has the ownership to improve fit where it´s needed and to raise concerns where needed.
* Drafting patterns both manually and digitally. Sewing toiles when needed.
* Oversee timelines throughout the development process, ensuring that projects are delivered on schedule and within scope and according to the calendar
* Collaborate closely with Design, PD & Production Dept.
* Contribute to identify key results and key objectives for elevated products
* Stay updated with industry trends, materials, and techniques to enhance pattern-making processes.
* Maintains detailed records of all patterns, including revisions, measurements, and material specifications.
* Creates a well-organized pattern archive for future reference and reusability.
* Develops patterns that minimize fabric waste and reduce costs, contributing to the overall efficiency of the production process.
* Utilizes pattern-making software (eg. Gerber, Clo 3D) to create and adjust patterns, ensuring technological efficiency.
* Balance and manage your time between both Malina and Soft Goat based on their timelines and needs
* Reason with a strategic way of planning ahead and identify solutions.
* Receive and give feedback



  





  





**Objectives** 



* **Ensure Accuracy of Patterns:** 
  Develop precise and accurate patterns based on designer sketches, specifications, or technical drawings to ensure a good fit.
* **Optimize Fit and Construction:** 
  Create patterns that facilitate an optimal fit for various body types, ensuring comfort, functionality, and aesthetic appeal.
* **Adapt Designs to Production Requirements:** 
  Modify and adjust patterns to meet production constraints, fabric limitations, and budget while maintaining the integrity of the original design.
* **Grading for Different Sizes:** 
  Ensure that grading works for multiple sizes, ensures consistency in design and fit across a full size range.
* **Collaborate Effectively with Designers:** 
  Work closely with designers to understand their vision and provide technical expertise to translate concepts into functional patterns.
* **Maintain Pattern Quality and Consistency:** 
  Ensure that patterns are of high quality, precise, and consistently adhere to design specifications, reducing errors in production.
* **Keep Detailed Records of Patterns:** 
  Maintain an organized archive of all patterns, revisions, and related documents for future reference, ensuring easy access to pattern history.
* **Ensure Compatibility with Fabrics:** 
  Account for fabric characteristics (e.g., stretch, drape, weight) when creating patterns to ensure the product aligns with design intentions.
* **Support Prototyping and Fittings:** 
  Collaborate with PD and Design at fittings to make necessary adjustments to patterns, ensuring the final garment meets design specifications.
* **Stay Current with Industry Trends and Techniques:** 
  Continuously improve knowledge of emerging pattern-making tools, software, and industry trends to stay competitive and improve efficiency.
* **Provide Technical Support to Design Teams:** 
  Offer guidance to Design for technical solutions and how the design can be improved regarding fit and design to improve production costs.
* **Ensure Compliance with Quality Standards:** 
  Create patterns that adhere to company and industry standards for quality, durability, and consistency.



  





**Working Tasks may include, but are not limited to:** 




  




* Drafting patterns manually & digitally
* Sewing Toiles
* Working across all product categories
* Grading patterns
* Creating patterns for special projects
* Working with the design team to incorporate feedback and adjustments into patterns.
* Reviewing production samples and troubleshooting any pattern-related issues during manufacturing.
* Updating and maintaining pattern libraries or digital archives for future use.
* Collaborating with Product developer.
* Communicating with production staff to resolve issues related to pattern design or garment production.
* Testing new materials and manufacturing techniques to optimize pattern-making processes.
* Scheduling and planning according to timeline
* Planning and executing meetings
* Travel according to need and budget.

title: Business R&D Team Leader
description:
**The opportunity**
 Hitachi Energy is a global leader in advancing a sustainable energy future. By delivering innovative solutions in electric power, we enable countries and industries to transition toward greener, more reliable, and efficient electricity systems. When you join us, you become part of a purpose-driven organization where technology, collaboration, and innovation go hand in hand.
   

  

 We are now looking for a Business R&D Team Leader to join our Control & Protection Design Organization. In this role, you will take on a key position combining technical leadership and people management, with accountability for design ownership, technical quality, and long-term capability development within R&D.
   

  

 You will lead a cross-functional team covering hardware, software, optical and mechanical engineering, ensuring strong technical direction and high product quality across the full lifecycle. This role is central to strengthening our R&D capabilities and supporting continued growth in a global, matrix organization.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Lead and develop a team of HW & SW engineers and consultants within Business R&D
* Take ownership of technical design, quality, and long-term sustainability of products
* Drive R&D strategies aligned with business objectives and technology roadmap
* Oversee the full R&D lifecycle – from concept and design to testing and pilot implementation
* Ensure strong architectural integrity and technical direction across projects
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders across functions to integrate R&D outcomes into products
* Manage resources, priorities, and competence development in a matrix organization
* Support innovation, continuous improvement, and future capability building within the team


**Your background**
* Master’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field
* 8–10+ years of experience in R&D, product development, or innovation
* Proven experience in a leadership role, combining people management and technical responsibility
* Strong understanding of multidisciplinary engineering environments (hardware, software, mechanical or optical)
* Experience working with full product lifecycle, including testing, verification, and industrialization
* Ability to drive technical strategy while managing complexity in a global matrix organization
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Experience in building teams, structures, and ways of working is highly valued


**More About Us**
 We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.
   

  

**Our Benefits Offering For Our Roles Generally Includes**
* Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)
* Group life insurance and additional insurances.
* Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank
* Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)
* Health care and wellness allowance
* Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)
* Psychological support program
* Supplementary compensation for parental leave
* Various trainings and education supporting employee development
* Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally
* Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks


 The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.

title: Produktägare till samhällsviktigt uppdrag
description:
*Är du en driven, förändringsorienterad och erfaren produktägare som brinner för digital utveckling i syfte att uppnå bästa möjliga användar- och samhällsnytta? Tycker du om att verka i en miljö där alla svaren ännu inte finns, där du har stor möjlighet att påverka den fortsatta förändringsresan?* 
*Välkommen till oss!* 



  


 Universitets- och högskolerådet (UHR) är en statlig myndighet med ett brett uppdrag i samhället. Vår vision är utbildning, utbyte och utveckling - för alla som vill vidare. Nu söker vi två erfarna Produktägare som vill ta en central roll i utvecklingen av några av UHR:s viktigaste digitala tjänster. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta med verksamhetskritiska system, bidra till samhällsviktiga uppdrag och påverka både produktutveckling och arbetssätt i en organisation med höga ambitioner inom digitalisering.
 


  


 Den ena rollen ansvarar för det nya uppdraget kring Medborgarskapsprovet. Här får du möjlighet att vara med från början och utveckla ett helt nytt systemstöd som ska skapa effektiva och användarvänliga processer för ett nytt nationellt uppdrag.
 


  


 Den andra rollen ansvarar för införandet av ett nytt myndighetsgemensamt handläggningssystem. Du kommer initialt att arbeta med kravställning, upphandling och införande, för att därefter ta ett långsiktigt produktägarskap för en lösning som blir central för myndighetens verksamhet.
 


  

 Vad du kommer att göra/ansvara för
   


 Som produktägare hos oss har du en nyckelroll i att omsätta myndighetens mål och användarnas behov till hållbara digitala lösningar med hög kvalitet och stort värde. Du ansvarar för produktens riktning, prioriteringar och utveckling över tid och arbetar nära verksamhet, användare, produktledning och utvecklingsorganisation för att säkerställa att rätt initiativ genomförs vid rätt tidpunkt.
 


  


 Hos oss får du inte bara utveckla din produkt. Du får också möjlighet att påverka våra gemensamma arbetssätt och bidra till ständiga förbättringar inom produktutveckling.
 


  


 Exempel på arbetsuppgifter
 


  

  
* Ansvara för produktens roadmap och prioriteringar utifrån myndighetens mål och användarnas behov.
  
* Driva produktens utveckling genom hela livscykeln och säkerställa att den fortsätter skapa värde över tid.
  
* Omsätta användarbehov, verksamhetskrav och strategiska mål till tydliga utvecklingsinitiativ, krav och user stories.
  
* Prioritera backlogg och utvecklingsinsatser utifrån nytta, effekt, kvalitet och verksamhetsvärde.
  
* Arbeta nära verksamhet, användare, produktledare, utvecklingsteam och systemleverantörer för att skapa hållbara och användarvänliga lösningar.
  
* Följa upp produktens kvalitet, stabilitet och resultat samt identifiera möjligheter till fortsatt utveckling.
  
* Bidra till att utveckla UHR:s arbetssätt inom produktstyrning, agil utveckling och kontinuerligt förbättringsarbete.
  


  

 Du som söker
   


 Vi söker dig som drivs av att utveckla, förbättra och skapa resultat tillsammans med andra. Hos oss får du arbeta i en verksamhet med höga ambitioner där du har möjlighet att påverka både din produkt och hur vi arbetar med digital utveckling i myndigheten.
 


  


 Du är van att skapa samsyn mellan olika intressenter och har förmåga att skapa samsyn mellan olika perspektiv. Du är lösningsorienterad, kommunikativ och trygg i att navigera i komplexa miljöer där olika roller, behov och perspektiv behöver samverka för att nå resultat.
 


  


 För att lyckas i rollen behöver du kunna kombinera helhetsperspektiv med handlingskraft, vara trygg i förändring och ha förmågan att driva utveckling framåt även när alla svar ännu inte finns.
 


  


***Kvalifikationer – krav***



  

  
* Akademisk examen inom relevant område, exempelvis IT, systemvetenskap, teknik eller ekonomi, alternativt motsvarande erfarenhet.
  
* Minst fem års erfarenhet av att självständigt leda och följa upp behovsdriven produktutveckling i en tvärfunktionell miljö med många intressenter och i enlighet med praxis inom verksamheten.
  
* Minst fem års erfarenhet av att ansvara för en produkts livscykel, inklusive behovsfångst, kravarbete, prioritering och utveckling.
  
* Minst fem års erfarenhet av att bidra i arbete med förbättring av arbetssätt och processer baserade på agil produktutveckling.
  
* Stor erfarenhet av systemintegrationer eller utveckling i komplexa IT-miljöer.
  
* Mycket god förmåga att skapa struktur, bygga förtroende och samverka med olika kompetenser och intressenter.
  
* Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.
  


  


***Det är meriterande om du har***



  

  
* Erfarenhet av att samarbeta med externa partners och bygga långsiktiga, värdeskapande relationer.
  
* Erfarenhet av kontinuerligt förbättringsarbete för både produkter och arbetssätt.
  
* Erfarenhet av kravställning vid upphandling eller vidareutveckling av inköpta system och externa systemlösningar.
  
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta datadrivet med uppföljning, nyckeltal och effekthemtagning.
  
* Vana att arbeta i verktyg som Jira, Azure DevOps eller motsvarande.
  


  


 Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.
 


  

 Vad vi gör och erbjuder
   


 UHR har flera uppdrag i samhället vars gemensamma nämnare är att skapa möjligheter till utveckling för Sveriges medborgare. Vi är cirka 320 anställda i Solna och Visby.
 


  


 Vi erbjuder en professionell och stimulerande miljö med goda möjligheter till personlig utveckling. Vi värnar om en rekrytering fri från diskriminering och ser inte ytterligare anpassningar som ett hinder.
 


  

 Avdelningen för digitalisering och tjänsteutveckling
   


 Avdelningen för digitalisering och tjänsteutveckling ansvarar för att utifrån ett helhetsperspektiv på myndigheten driva och skapa förutsättningar för effektiv IT-utveckling och nyttjande av digitaliseringens möjligheter. Avdelningen arbetar med hela kedjan, från nationell samverkan, strategiarbete, behovsfångst till genomförande av tjänste- och produktutveckling, infrastruktur och användarsupport.
 


  

 Enheten Produktutveckling och leverans
   


 Enheten Produktutveckling och leverans är en del av avdelningen för digitalisering och tjänsteutveckling med livscykelansvar för myndighetens digitala produkter, i syfte att ge högre nytta för medborgare och samhället. Här finns myndighetens produktledare och produktägare samlade. Större delen av vår utveckling görs av externa leverantörer, som vi har ett tätt samarbete med.
 


  

 Ansök och bli en av oss!
   


 Välkommen med din ansökan i form av CV på svenska märkt med diarienummer 2.2.1-01484-2026. När du gör din ansökan vill vi att du besvarar ett antal urvalsfrågor. Vi kommer i det första urvalet att utgå från svaren på dessa frågor. Sista ansökningsdatum är 22 september 2026.
 


  


 Anställningen omfattar heltid och gäller tillsvidare med tillträde efter överenskommelse. UHR tillämpar sex månaders provanställning. Placeringsort är Solna.
 


  


 Våra villkor och förmåner
 


  


 Mer om UHR
 


  


 Har du några frågor om rekryteringen är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Charlotte Arfwidson tfn. Mobil: +46 72 226 53 56. Representant för Saco-S är Kerstin Martínez tfn. 010- 470 04 69 och för ST Anneli Schönning tfn. 010-470 05 76 alt. e-mail: st@uhr.se.
 


  


 Universitets- och högskolerådet har gjort medieval för denna rekrytering. Vi undanber oss därför kontakt med annonssäljare eller andra säljare av rekryteringstjänster.

title: Junior Audio & Acoustic Engineer – Headphones
description:
Stockholm
   

  

* Hybrid


 Junior Audio & Acoustic Engineer – Headphones
   

  

 Marshall Group is the audio, tech, and design powerhouse uniting musicians and music lovers through genre-breaking innovation. Our flagship brand, Marshall, is uniquely positioned with over 60 years of rock ‘n’ roll attitude on stage, at home, and on the go. Our iconic products are brought to life by a dedicated team of 800 passionate employees and sold in over 90 markets worldwide.
   

  

 Right now, we need to strengthen our
 **Audio & Acoustics** 
 team with an
 **Audio & Acoustic Engineer** 
 who will focus on
 **securing and validating the acoustic design for our headphones** 
 and
 **ensuring our products meet the audio requirements demanded by our brand** 
 .
   

  

****What You’ll Do:****
 As an Audio & Acoustic Engineer, you'll be a key member of project teams, working alongside other engineering and design specialists as well as our ODM partners to secure and validate the acoustic design for our headphones. You'll work with simulations, prototyping, measurement, and subjective evaluations to achieve the best possible performance, and join a growing team of passionate engineers with a wealth of experience from across the audio industry. Goals and development opportunities can be tailored to your individual strengths and areas of interest.
   

  

****Roles & Responsibilities:****
* Contribute to product development projects as a member of the audio & acoustics team.
* Perform acoustic and audio electronics measurements and subjective evaluation.
* Contribute to product documentation, development tests, and production test specifications.
* Collaborate with external partners to take internally developed acoustic concepts into production-ready products.
* Develop DSP (Digital Signal Processing) to support hardware functionality and achieve the desired product voicing.
* Validate all aspects of the audio design through hands-on measurements and by leveraging vendor resources.


****Who We’re Looking For:****
 Someone with a strong interest in audio and acoustics and a genuine drive to build products that impact people's daily lives. You're self-motivated, comfortable working independently, and take initiative. You can create and communicate design solutions fluently in English, both spoken and written, and you enjoy collaborating closely with cross-functional teams and external partners.
   

  

****You Probably Have The Following Experiences & Skills:****
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in acoustic engineering or a relevant field.
* Good knowledge of theoretical acoustics, signal processing, and audio technologies.
* Familiarity with standard acoustic measurement procedures and common test equipment.
* Basic knowledge of acoustic simulations (e.g., lumped-parameter models, boundary elements, or finite element modelling).
* Basic programming skills, with familiarity using Python, MATLAB, and Git for version control.
* Knowledge of and interest in product development for consumer electronics.


****Our Pledge:****
 We strive to foster an inclusive workplace, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, disability, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age or marital status. We firmly believe that Marshall thrives when our employees do, leading to better experiences for our consumers.
   

  

 We encourage applications from all over the world. To enable transitioning from another country for a role at Marshall, we offer relocation support. This support is tailored for each role but always includes visa/work permit application, local authority registration, and home finding service. Don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.
   

  

**Does this sound like you?**
 We look forward to reviewing your application!
   

  

 Remote status Hybrid
   

  

 Stockholm

****You Probably Have The Following Experiences & Skills:****
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in acoustic engineering or a relevant field.
* Good knowledge of theoretical acoustics, signal processing, and audio technologies.
* Familiarity with standard acoustic measurement procedures and common test equipment.
* Basic knowledge of acoustic simulations (e.g., lumped-parameter models, boundary elements, or finite element modelling).
* Basic programming skills, with familiarity using Python, MATLAB, and Git for version control.
* Knowledge of and interest in product development for consumer electronics.


****Our Pledge:****
 We strive to foster an inclusive workplace, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, disability, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age or marital status. We firmly believe that Marshall thrives when our employees do, leading to better experiences for our consumers.
   

  

 We encourage applications from all over the world. To enable transitioning from another country for a role at Marshall, we offer relocation support. This support is tailored for each role but always includes visa/work permit application, local authority registration, and home finding service. Don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.
   

  

**Does this sound like you?**
 We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Product Designer
description:
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Product Designer to join our Core Experience team based in our Stockholm office. In this role, you will take ownership of user touchpoints outside core sports and casino play - including signup flows, verification journeys, responsible gaming touchpoints, and promotional experiences across major global brands like BetMGM and LeoVegas. You will work closely with a talented cross-functional pod consisting of Product Managers, Engineers, QA, and Product Researchers, collaborating daily to translate user needs into clear, intuitive digital experiences.
   

  

 As part of the Nordic market cluster, you will balance user-centered design principles with strict regulatory and compliance requirements. Your daily focus will involve designing accessible interface flows, validating concepts through data and rapid prototyping in Figma, and contributing directly to our scalable multi-brand design system. This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing product design unit in Stockholm where your work directly impacts millions of active players worldwide.
   

  

**You Will Be Responsible For**
* Owning the end-to-end design process (UX/UI) for the Nordic market cluster across web and native mobile apps.
* Designing intuitive, accessible interfaces (WCAG standards) that balance compliance requirements with a seamless user experience.
* Collaborating with cross-functional partners (PMs, Engineers, QA, and UX Researchers) to move features smoothly from discovery to launch.
* Utilizing Figma to build scalable components, wireframes, and interactive prototypes for rapid testing and dev handoff.
* Using data, user feedback, and A/B test results to continuously improve conversion, retention, and onboarding workflows.
* Communicating design strategy clearly to partners and keeping overall product consistency top-of-mind.


**Essential Skills**
**OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING:**
* Minimum of 3 years of experience as a UX/UI or Product Designer working on digital products.
* Advanced proficiency with Figma and experience building or contributing to design systems.
* Strong understanding of digital accessibility principles and designing for compliance or regulated user flows.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a positive and open attitude towards adopting modern AI workflows.
* Self-motivated and pragmatic approach, able to execute tasks efficiently without over-complicating simple requirements.


**NICE TO HAVES**
* Experience with UI animations, micro-interactions, or prototyping tools like ProtoPie.
* Knowledge of the iGaming industry, Fintech, or sports betting environments.


**Who We Are**
 At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We're a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.

* 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply)

* Occupational Pension
* 5,000 SEK wellness contribution annually
* Parental Leave Top-Up
* Possibility to enrol in a private health care insurance for both you and your partner
* 1,500 SEK equipment allowance
* Benify - benefits portal with many offers and discounts


**JOIN US!**
 In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don't wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!
   

  

 Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar!
