title: Product Manager till Datamodellteamet i Data & AI-domänen
description:
**Om oss - Data & AI**  

Vår Data & AI-avdelning är hjärtat i vår datadrivna utveckling och spelar en central roll i att omvandla information till affärsvärde. Teamen består av data scientists, data engineers, utvecklare, AI-specialister och UX-are som tillsammans bygger och förvaltar lösningar inom avancerad datamodellering, maskininlärning och automatisering.


Avdelningen arbetar tvärfunktionellt och nära verksamheten för att identifiera möjligheter där data och AI kan skapa konkreta resultat – från prediktiva modeller och insikter till intelligenta produkter och tjänster. Vi hanterar hela kedjan, från datainsamling och dataplattformar till modellutveckling, implementering och möjliggör uppföljning i verksamheten.


Hos oss präglas arbetet av innovation, samarbete och ett starkt fokus på kvalitet och säkerhet. Vi strävar efter att ligga i framkant inom modern teknik och använder verktyg och metoder som möjliggör skalbara och hållbara lösningar.


**Om rollen**  

Ett av våra datateam, Datamodeller, behöver en Product Manager som leder teamet på fem utvecklare i det dagliga arbetet samt agerar som en stark kommunikativ spelare gentemot teamet och domänens stakeholders. Vi arbetar i Big Query med data från hela Bonnier News och i nära samarbete med Analys, Commercial, Editorial och Product.


En strategisk förflyttning har påbörjats mot att etablera Data Mesh, Dataprodukter, dbt, som arbetssätt i organisationen. Denna förflyttning behöver drivkraft vilket vi ser att personen i denna roll tillför. Vi har också ett behov i domänen och på Bonnier av någon som agerar “Datageneral”, som tar helhetsansvar för våra dataflöden och hur vi vill jobba med dem. Vi behöver föra ut vår datastrategi i organisationen. I och med detta behöver du ha stark bakgrund och teknisk kompetens om hur vi vill jobba med data framåt och kunna föra talan för detta mot andra delar av organisationen och i olika utvecklarforum och liknande. Det är nödvändigt att tänka helhet och arkitektur för dataflöden som behöver moderniseras, effektiviseras och automatiseras för att kunna generera värde mot såväl AI som användare i organisationen.


I rollen ingår du i Data & AI-domänens ledningsgrupp vilket ger dig stor möjlighet att vara med och påverka kortsiktiga och långsiktiga beslut inom domänen. Samt datastrategin framåt på hela Bonnier News.


***Dina främsta arbetsuppgifter är att:***

* ansvara för att bygga goda relationer med domänens stakeholders och andra intressenter
* ansvara för att driva arbetet med Bonnier News datastrategi framåt i rätt riktning och ta ansvar för att driva igenom förändringar kring den om det behövs
* att leda teamet Datamodeller i deras dagliga arbete vilket innebär att ge teamet rätt förutsättningar och rätt prioritering i vad de ska utföra

**Vem är du?**  

Utöver det som redan är beskrivet ovan behöver du vara modig och ta egna initiativ och ha en personlighet som trivs i en föränderlig värld då möjligheterna med AI gör att omvärlden och vår domän anpassar sig i snabb takt.


***Kvalifikationer:***

* Relevant universitets- eller högskoleutbildning inom data/IT, ingenjörsvetenskap eller motsvarande.
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet från en datadriven roll inom digital media, varav minst 2-3 år i en roll fokuserad på dataanalys, data engineering eller data strategy.
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att arbeta i molnbaserade data warehouse (vi använder
* Google BigQuery ) och praktisk erfarenhet av datamodellering och ETL/ELT-
* processer.
* Avancerade kunskaper i SQL är ett krav för rollen, då detta är ditt primära
* arbetsverktyg för analys, transformation och kvalitetssäkring.
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att hantera storskaliga datamiljöer i molnprojekt.
* Erfarenhet av ledningsarbete som PM/Teamlead/PO: Framgångsrik implementering av KPI:er och OKR:er för att skapa samstämmighet i teamet.
* **Meriterande** : Erfarenhet av molnmigrering och infrastrukturprojekt, inklusive utveckling av skalbara arkitekturer och harmonisering av data mellan olika miljöer.

**Övrig information:**  

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning.
  

**Placering är flexibel och sker på något av våra kontor enligt överenskommelse.**

title: Light Designer – fordonsbelysning
description:
Forma framtidens ljusupplevelser i och på fordon – från tidiga koncept och simulering till prototyper och produktionsnära lösningar.
  
Vill du skapa ljusupplevelser som förenar design, teknik, säkerhet och känsla? I den här rollen får du utveckla framtida belysningskoncept för fordon, från första idé till prototyp och genomförbar lösning.
  
Om rollen
  
Du ingår i ett tvärfunktionellt design- och innovationssammanhang inom fordonsindustrin.
  
Rollen omfattar både interiör och exteriör fordonsbelysning.
  
Du samarbetar nära designers, UX-specialister, materialexperter och ingenjörer.
  
  

Det här kommer du göra
  
Ta fram ljuskoncept för ambient, funktionell och kommunikativ belysning.
  
Integrera ljuslösningar i fordonets former, ytor, skarvar och material.
  
Utvärdera ljuseffekter, integration och genomförbarhet med visualisering, simulering och VR.
  
Bygga och validera prototyper tillsammans med interna team och externa leverantörer.
  
Presentera designintention och koncept för relevanta intressenter.
  
  

Vi söker dig som har
  
Högskoleutbildning inom industri-, produkt-, transport-, interaktions- eller ljusdesign, eller motsvarande.
  
Minst fem års erfarenhet av ljusdesign inom fordonsindustrin eller närliggande områden.
  
En stark portfolio som visar utveckling av ljuskoncept och designlösningar.
  
Förmåga att omsätta koncept till tekniskt och tillverkningsmässigt genomförbara lösningar.
  
Praktisk erfarenhet av prototypframtagning samt grundläggande förståelse för elektronik och el.
  
  

Teknik & Verktyg
  
Verktyg för ljusdesign och visualisering.
  
Ljussimulering och VR för konceptvalidering.
  
Rapid prototyping.
  
Kunskap om regelverk och begränsningar för fordonsbelysning är meriterande.
  
  

Praktisk information
  
**Ort:** Göteborg.
  
**Arbetssätt:** Hybrid, med kontoret som huvudsaklig arbetsplats och viss möjlighet till distansarbete.
  
**Språk:** Engelska, flytande i tal och skrift.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!**



Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here's why we stand out:
* We are trusted by over 500 million active users every month across 190+ countries
* We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
* We are powered by a team of 400+ employees from 45+ nationalities


We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you'll fit right in.


**The role:**



You will be the Senior Product Manager for the Truecaller iOS app. You'll work across multiple surfaces of the app: Caller ID & Spam Blocking, Premium subscriptions, Onboarding, Family Protection, and a fast-growing Travel eSIM business. This is a broad, senior IC role. You get real autonomy and real accountability. You find the problems worth solving, build conviction with data, ship, measure & iterate. The right person is hands-on. You prototype your own ideas, write your own queries, and use AI as a force multiplier, not a novelty. You care about craft, in the product and in how you communicate.


**What you'll do:**


* Own the roadmap for multiple product surfaces, from quarterly plans down to individual tickets
* Run high-velocity experiments: design A/B tests, define success metrics, read results honestly, kill your own ideas when the data says so
* Prioritize ruthlessly. Engineering capacity is finite, and the surface is large; you decide what doesn't get built
* Partner daily with engineering, design, and data analysts
* Be the voice of the customer: user interviews, App Store reviews, support tickets, and turn that signal into roadmap decisions
* Communicate clearly: weekly updates, decision docs, and the occasional hard conversation with stakeholders
* Prototype with AI tools and pick up small dev tickets yourself (within guardrails)


**What you bring:**


* 5+ years in product management, mostly on consumer mobile apps at scale
* Deep knowledge of the iOS ecosystem: App Store dynamics, iOS frameworks, Apple's platform constraints, In-App Purchase mechanics
* A great sense of design. You can tell good UX from poor UX and explain why
* Fluency in experimentation: hypothesis design, A/B testing, reading results, statistical significance
* Embrace ambiguity and create clarity where there is none
* Comfort using AI end-to-end: prototyping, analyzing data, executing small dev tasks yourself
* Fast learner. You pick up new domains (payments, telecom, platform APIs) quickly
* Strong written and verbal communication


**It would be great if you also have:**


* Previous dev experience, especially mobile. You can read code and earn engineers' respect
* Experience taking over an established product with millions of users, where every change carries real risk
* Exposure to subscriptions, payments, or telecom products


**What we offer:**



We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:

* **A comprehensive compensation package:** We offer a competitive salary, 30 days of paid vacation, private health insurance, parental leave top-up, pension, and wellness contributions.
* **Modern tools to do your best work:** Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
* **A people-focused office culture:** We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch, and well-stocked snack stations and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
* **Truecaller's "Lab Days" offer a space for imagination:** 5 times per year for 3 days, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they've always wanted to. It's a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.


**Come as you are:**  

Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.


**Check out Life at Truecaller - Behind the code:** https://www.instagram.com/lifeattruecaller/



Sounds like a great opportunity?



We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.


**We only accept applications in English.**

title: Senior Conversion Optimization Manager
description:
Join Forterro's Digital Center of Excellence (CoE) and play a key role in advancing our digital growth and experimentation capabilities across a complex, multi-site ecosystem of 20+ websites.  

  

This is a high-impact, hands-on role focused on driving measurable improvements in lead generation, pipeline contribution, and customer experience through structured experimentation and data-driven decision making. Working across multiple markets, products, and digital experiences, you will help shape how websites evolve by translating insights, customer behavior, and business objectives into meaningful optimization initiatives.  

  

As a central contributor to Forterro's web experimentation capability, you will collaborate with stakeholders across Marketing, and other functions, to identify opportunities, prioritize improvements, and build a scalable culture of continuous optimization. The role combines strategic thinking with practical execution, managing the full experimentation lifecycle from research and hypothesis creation through implementation, analysis, and insight sharing.  

  

Beyond delivering measurable performance improvements, you will contribute to developing frameworks, best practices, and operating models that help increase experimentation maturity and digital effectiveness across the organization.
  
**Responsibilities**
  
* Drive structured experimentation and conversion optimization initiatives across multiple websites and customer journeys.
* Define and manage the experimentation roadmap, backlog, and prioritization based on business impact and opportunity.
* Translate customer insights, behavioral data, and analytics into clear hypotheses and measurable optimization initiatives.
* Champion data-driven decision making by ensuring recommendations are supported by research, testing, and performance insights.
* Optimize landing pages, forms, and key conversion journeys across paid and organic traffic channels.
* Partner with Analytics and Web teams to coordinate delivery, prioritization, and execution of optimization initiatives.
* Collaborate with SEO, Paid Media, Marketing Operations, Product, and UX stakeholders to improve conversion performance and lead quality.
* Establish scalable testing frameworks, processes, and best practices across a diverse multi-site environment.
* Manage the end-to-end experimentation process, including research, prioritization, test design, implementation, analysis, and reporting.
* Support the continued development of experimentation capabilities, tools, and methodologies across the Digital CoE.

  
**Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**
  
* Strong experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), growth, digital performance, or experimentation-focused roles.
* Proven track record of running structured experimentation programs and delivering measurable business impact.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to convert data into actionable insights and optimization opportunities.
* Experience influencing stakeholders and driving cross-functional initiatives in complex organizations.
* Deep understanding of UX principles, customer behavior, conversion optimization, and funnel analysis.
* Experience working across multiple websites, brands, products, or digital ecosystems.
* Familiarity with analytics, testing, and experimentation platforms.
* Comfortable collaborating with developers, analysts, designers, and marketers in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to operate across strategy, execution, prioritization, and delivery while maintaining momentum.
* Experience in adjacent marketing disciplines such as SEO, Paid Media, Marketing Operations, or Lifecycle Marketing is advantageous.
* Experience with AI-assisted productivity and workflow tools such as Codex, Cursor, Claude Code/cowork, Copilot Studio, OpenClaw, or similar platforms is a plus.

  
**Über Forterro**
  
Forterro wurde 2012 gegründet und hat sich zu einem der führenden Anbieter von Industriesoftware entwickelt - mit Niederlassungen in den wichtigsten Produktionsländern Europas sowie regionalen Servicezentren und Entwicklungszentren auf der ganzen Welt. Von mehr als 40 Standorten aus stellen unsere über 2,500 Mitarbeiter Software für mehr als 13.000 Industrieunternehmen bereit und unterstützen diese. Unsere Produkte sind tief in den Anforderungen der jeweiligen Region verwurzelt. Jedes Produkt ist darauf ausgerichtet, die Fähigkeit unserer Kunden zu stärken und zu beschleunigen, effizient zu arbeiten und wettbewerbsfähig zu sein.

Marketing
Beschäftigungsart
Festanstellung

Schweden, Remote

title: Vi söker en bibliotekarie – inriktning vuxen
description:
Stockholm – vår huvudstad med miljoner drömmar, förväntningar och ambitioner. Vi jobbar för alla som lever här idag och i framtiden. Nu söker vi dig som vill tänka stort, nytt och annorlunda med oss – för stockholmarna.


Kultur är en viktig del av Stockholms nervsystem och berör miljontals människor varje år. På Kulturförvaltningen arbetar vi tillsammans för att stärka kulturlivet i Stockholm.  

Hos oss råder ett öppet arbetsklimat där medarbetarna i allra högsta grad är delaktiga i utvecklingen. Var med och bidra till att Stockholm växer med kultur!

### **Välkommen till oss**


Nu har du möjlighet att bli en del av Stockholms stadsbibliotek. Våra fyrtio bibliotek är fyllda med viktig och spännande verksamhet, och hos oss får du ca 450 engagerade kollegor. Vi arbetar för att tillsammans med stockholmarna skapa en inspirerande verksamhet som möter våra besökares behov. Biblioteken finns till för alla!  

  

Kärnan är alltid mötet: möten mellan människor och ordet, mellan läsaren och boken, mellan användaren och tekniken i biblioteksrummet, mellan besökaren och personalen. Här främjar vi intresset för läsning, litteratur, bildning och kultur. Vi ger barns och ungdomars behov särskild plats och uppmärksamhet.
  

  

På Stockholms stadsbibliotek jobbar vi för det demokratiska samhällets utveckling genom att bidra till kunskapsförmedling och fri åsiktsbildning. Vi som arbetar i Stockholms stad bidrar till att forma ett hållbart Stockholm där alla kan växa

### **Din arbetsplats**


Enheten Farsta Skarpnäck är en del av Stockholms stadsbibliotek och består av biblioteken Farsta, Gubbängen, Sköndal, Björkhagen, Bagarmossen och Skarpnäck. Enhetens bibliotek är fördelade mellan två olika stadsdelsområden, Farsta och Skarpnäck. Två bibliotek i enheten, Sköndal och Gubbängen, är också meröppna vilket innebär att besökare med access kan använda biblioteket även när det inte är bemannat. Alla enhetens bibliotek verkar för och tillsammans med lokalsamhället. Enheten har ca 55 medarbetare och arbetet leds av en enhetschef och en gruppchef.


Du ingår i ett mindre arbetslag på Gubbängens bibliotek men är också en del av hela enhetens personalgrupp. Gubbängen är ett välbesökt nybyggt bibliotek och ett av enhetens två meröppna bibliotek.

### **Vi erbjuder**


Hos oss får du ett viktigt arbete där varje möte med våra användare är fyllt av mening. Stockholms stadsbibliotek erbjuder alla fri tillgång till kultur, bildning, information och samhällsservice. Vi som arbetar i Stockholms stad bidrar till att forma ett hållbart Stockholm där alla kan växa. Tillsammans skapar vi en klimatsmart stad som utmärks av social, ekonomisk och demokratisk hållbarhet.  

  

Stockholms stad är en av Sveriges största arbetsgivare och Stockholms stadsbibliotek är Sveriges största folkbibliotek. Det innebär att du blir del av ett större sammanhang där det finns möjlighet att lära nytt, utvecklas, prova nya saker, och engagera sig i olika frågor. Inom organisationen erbjuds du kompetensutveckling: både digitalt via en lärportal, och fysiskt genom utbildningar och kurser, konferenser och utbyten. Genom UX-metodik främjar vi ett kreativt förhållningssätt till utveckling där användarna alltid är i fokus.
  

  

Att vara anställd inom Stockholms stad innebär att du har rollen som tjänsteperson. Det betyder att du har ett ansvar för att göra ditt bästa, och för att leverera på det uppdrag vi har fått från det politiska styret i staden. Det är grunden i det demokratiska mandat som vi har fått av medborgarna. Alla bidrar – alla är viktiga.
  

  

Läs mer om Stockholms stadsbibliotek här: Stockholms stadsbibliotek  

Läs vår biblioteksplan här: Biblioteksplan — Stockholms stadsbibliotek  

  

Länkar till förmåner och beskrivning av förvaltning finns längst ner.

### **Din roll**


I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår att dagligen möta och hjälpa besökare i alla åldrar, att arbeta med bibliotekets böcker och tidskrifter, samt att vägleda och stötta besökare i digitala tjänster och den teknik som är kopplad till bibliotekets erbjudande. Du har god förståelse för bibliotekets samhällsuppdrag, och du är bekväm i att arbeta läsfrämjande mot både barn, unga och vuxna stockholmare. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår att utföra administrativa uppgifter kopplade till bibliotekets verksamhet.  

  

Du är serviceinriktad och har ett varmt, inkluderande och professionellt bemötande. Du har en förmåga att bidra till goda möten med bibliotekets besökare antingen de vill ha litteraturtips, informationsvägledning eller hjälp med kopiatorn. Du trivs i en föränderlig miljö där du bidrar till att verksamheten och bibliotekets fysiska miljöer når sin fulla potential. Du arbetar strukturerat och har förmåga att planera och styra ditt arbete, men du trivs också i en verksamhet där du får improvisera och fånga möjligheten. Du är en trygg och stabil person i biblioteksrummet och i arbetsgruppen är du en lagspelare.
  

  

Som bibliotekarie hos oss har du en nyckelroll i att utveckla bibliotekets läsfrämjande arbete och informationsförmedling. Du arbetar med bibliotekets böcker och tidskrifter, och du genomför publika program och aktiviteter. Du planerar, genomför och utvärderar arbetet, med sikte på utveckling och förbättringar. Du främjar i ditt möte med stockholmarna delaktighet och medskapande.

### **Din kompetens och erfarenhet**


Vi söker dig som är påhittig och kreativ med en utpräglad förmåga och vilja till samarbete. Du är nyfiken och omvärldsorienterad och vill utveckla verksamhet och lära nytt. Du har en god pedagogisk förmåga och trivs med att möta besökare i alla åldrar. Verksamhet för barn och unga är prioriterat och barn i förskoleåldern och deras vuxna är frekventa besökare på Gubbängens bibliotek där denna tjänst i huvudsak är placerad.


Du har förmåga att bidra till goda möten med bibliotekets besökare och har erfarenhet av att utveckla och arbeta med läs- och litteraturfrämjande aktiviteter för besökare i olika åldrar. Du ser också möjligheter med att genomföra verksamhet utanför bibliotekets fysiska väggar.


Då du kommer att ingå i ett mindre arbetslag där alla hjälps åt med att uppfylla uppdraget är det viktigt att du är inställd på att arbeta med alla de olika arbetsuppgifter som finns på ett mindre bibliotek. Det kan gälla allt från litteraturtips till att hjälpa besökare med grundläggande medborgerliga ärenden. Den viktiga medborgarservicen är en bärande del av bibliotekets sätt att arbeta med det lagstadgade uppdraget om bildning, informationsteknik och demokrati. Ditt arbete blir en viktig del för att säkerställa medborgarservice och att utveckla innehållet i takt med samhällets behov.


För rollen krävs att du har kandidatexamen inom biblioteks- och informationsvetenskap eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer vara likvärdig. Du ska ha:

* Kunskap om metoder inom pedagogik, informations- och litteraturförmedling.
* God och bred litteraturkännedom
* God digital kompetens och förmåga att inspirera och hjälpa kollegor och besökare
* Kunskap om medie- och informationskunnighet och på ett pedagogiskt sätt kunna förmedla det till våra användare.

title: Senior Conversion Optimization Manager
description:
Join Forterro's Digital Center of Excellence (CoE) and play a key role in advancing our digital growth and experimentation capabilities across a complex, multi-site ecosystem of 20+ websites.  

This is a high-impact, hands-on role focused on driving measurable improvements in lead generation, pipeline contribution, and customer experience through structured experimentation and data-driven decision making. Working across multiple markets, products, and digital experiences, you will help shape how websites evolve by translating insights, customer behavior, and business objectives into meaningful optimization initiatives.  

As a central contributor to Forterro's web experimentation capability, you will collaborate with stakeholders across Marketing, and other functions, to identify opportunities, prioritize improvements, and build a scalable culture of continuous optimization. The role combines strategic thinking with practical execution, managing the full experimentation lifecycle from research and hypothesis creation through implementation, analysis, and insight sharing.  

Beyond delivering measurable performance improvements, you will contribute to developing frameworks, best practices, and operating models that help increase experimentation maturity and digital effectiveness across the organization.

Marketing

Permanent

Hybride

* Define and manage the experimentation roadmap, backlog, and prioritization based on business impact and opportunity.
* Translate customer insights, behavioral data, and analytics into clear hypotheses and measurable optimization initiatives.
* Champion data-driven decision making by ensuring recommendations are supported by research, testing, and performance insights.
* Optimize landing pages, forms, and key conversion journeys across paid and organic traffic channels.
* Partner with Analytics and Web teams to coordinate delivery, prioritization, and execution of optimization initiatives.

title: Senior Service Designer – Digital Services
description:
#### **Senior Service Designer – Digital Services | Consulting Assignment in Gothenburg**


Are you an experienced Service Designer who enjoys solving complex challenges through human-centered design? We at WeQuel are currently looking for a Senior Service Designer for a consulting assignment with one of our clients in Gothenburg. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of digital services by creating seamless customer experiences that connect users, business, and technology.


As a consultant with us, you will have the opportunity to work with some of our clients who are leading companies within the pharmaceutical, manufacturing, and industrial sectors, contributing to process optimization, implementation of new technologies, and the development of sustainable solutions.

##### **About the Role:**


In this role, you will join an experienced design organization focused on developing digital services and customer experiences. You will lead service design initiatives from early discovery through implementation, working closely with UX designers, product teams, service owners, engineers, and business stakeholders.


The role requires a strong hands-on design background combined with the ability to navigate complex organizations, facilitate collaboration, and translate customer insights into scalable service concepts and tangible improvements. You will play a key role in connecting customer needs, business objectives, operational processes, and digital products to create valuable end-to-end experiences.

##### **Your main responsibilities will include:**

* Lead service design initiatives across complex digital services
* Map, analyze, and improve end-to-end customer and user journeys
* Translate research findings and customer insights into service concepts, priorities, and improvements
* Create service blueprints connecting customer experiences with business processes, systems, and capabilities
* Collaborate closely with UX Designers, Service Owners, Product, Technology, and Business teams
* Facilitate workshops and stakeholder alignment sessions
* Connect design initiatives to measurable business outcomes such as customer value, adoption, productivity, and operational efficiency
* Drive design initiatives independently from discovery through implementation
* Ensure design recommendations are translated into actionable improvements

##### **We are looking for someone who:**

* Has 10+ years of experience in Service Design, Customer Experience Design, or a closely related design discipline
* Has a strong portfolio demonstrating hands-on design work, design thinking, process, and measurable outcomes (**applications without a portfolio cannot be considered**)
* Has extensive experience conducting user research, synthesis, customer journey mapping, and service blueprinting
* Has strong systems thinking and can connect customer needs, digital products, business, technology, and operations
* Has experience working in complex organizations with multiple stakeholders
* Has the ability to balance customer needs with business and operational objectives
* Has a strong human-centered design mindset and hands-on experience driving service design initiatives
* Is a T-shaped designer with deep expertise in Experience Design complemented by Service Design and Business Design capabilities
* Is comfortable working independently in ambiguous environments and driving initiatives forward

##### **Meritorious Experience:**

* Experience with B2B products or services
* Experience within industrial products or manufacturing environments
* Experience with SaaS platforms or digital products
* Experience with connected services, IoT, telematics, or fleet management solutions
* Experience working with dealer ecosystems or global digital products

##### **We Offer:**


At WeQuel, you become part of a consulting team that values people first – we believe that success is built through engagement, collaboration, and development. We offer a flat organization with short decision-making paths, a strong sense of community, and the opportunity to influence your own professional growth.

title: Test Object Engineer Powertrain
description:
### **Job description**


**About the role**


We offer you a role where technology meets coordination and problem-solving.


Sigma is looking for a Test Object Engineer within Powertrain who wants to become part of Sigma and work in an exciting customer assignment within product development and testing. In this role, you will play an important part in ensuring that test objects (engines) are correctly specified and ready for verification and testing.


You will work with identifying the components and materials required to install and use test objects in different test environments. You will be responsible for specifying, planning, and coordinating material needs, as well as handling orders for components and spare parts. You will also review and correct Bill of Materials (BOM) and ensure that information is accurate and up to date in relevant systems and databases.


You will work closely with other engineers, planners, and specialists throughout the different phases of the projects. Together with your colleagues, you will plan and coordinate test objects and ensure that the right materials are available at the right place and at the right time. The role involves many cross-functional contacts, and you will become an important point of contact for questions related to components and material needs. Your main responsibilities include:


* Specify and order components and installation material for test objects
* Plan and coordinate material needs for builds
* Own, review, quality-assure, and correct BOMs
* Keep systems, databases, and order documentation up to date

**Experience requirements**


We are looking for someone with a technical university degree. We would like you to have at least a couple of years of experience within the automotive industry, for example in product development, testing, prototype builds, material preparation, or a similar technical field.


To succeed in this role, we believe you have a good technical understanding and enjoy the combination of mechanics, structure, and coordination. You need to understand component and material needs, work methodically with technical information, and manage several parallel activities.


You are communicative, collaborative, and comfortable working with many different stakeholders. We would like you to become a natural point of contact that colleagues turn to for questions and guidance within your area.


As a person, you are structured, solution-oriented, and thorough. You enjoy taking responsibility, creating structure, and driving topics forward while valuing close collaboration with the team.


**Requirements**


* At least 2 years of relevant experience within testing, engine development, or automotive development
* Experience with BOMs, component management, or technical purchasing/order handling
* Good ability to coordinate and collaborate in cross-functional teams
* B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, or equivalent

**Meritorious**


* **Good knowledge of Swedish is considered highly meritorious**
* Experience with Internal Combustion Engines (ICE)
* Experience from prototype or development activities within the automotive industry
* Experience with CAD & PLM systems

**What can we offer?**
  

As an employee with us, you get the opportunity to work across multiple areas with our clients – essentially the best part of being a consultant – but with the security of a single employer! We deliver specialized expertise in areas such as Product Development, UX & Design, PLM, Industrial IT, Production Engineering, and Project Management. Once on assignment, you’ll either be on-site with a client or working on projects from our lovely office, located in the heart of Lindholmen Science Park.


We enjoy doing things together and strive for a good balance between work and leisure. This could include after-work gatherings, events, fitness activities, ski trips, or inspirational talks. We have shared many fun trips together, and in September 2024 we returned from South Africa(!) where we celebrated 10 years as a consulting company!


Professional development has always been important to us. In addition to opportunities for growth through your consulting assignments and various technical trainings, we offer internal programs for personal development.


We also believe that autonomy, involvement, and influence create the motivation needed for you to achieve your personal goals. Our employees choose to work with us because we share this perspective on careers, the future, and life in general. With us, who you are is just as important as what you do. Our goal is to find a structure that gives you the chance to grow and develop into something great together with our clients.


**Sigma Group**
  

As part of the Sigma Group, we offer the best of both worlds: stability and an entrepreneurial spirit.


We are the “small company within the large Sigma,” consisting of several companies across different technical expertise areas. Today, we have over 5,000 employees and operate in 14 countries, making us Sweden’s largest privately-owned consulting group.


We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Product Designer
description:
**TL;DR** 
 - We’re looking for world-class product designers to help shape Lovable. You’ll lead projects end-to-end, collaborating closely with engineering. We expect a broad range of design skills, and exceptional taste. You’ll join a team at the forefront of AI, enabling anyone to create software.

 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

 Design Lovable, making it the most Lovable piece of software ever.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
**About the role** 




 We are looking for a Lead Product Designer who wants to shape a product that reduces emissions at sea, working alongside people who understand ship operations from the inside.
 



  





 We build the software that enables our Fleet Support Center to help clients reduce their costs, lower their emissions, and increase their operational efficiency. Our product combines opinionated, advanced analytics and a collaboration platform that ensures the right people work together to make a difference.
 



  





 As our first dedicated in-house designer and an integral part of our product team, you will also interact with our colleagues in Fleet Support Center Operations every week. That means you work closely with a group of people that includes product owners, former seafarers turned center operators, and PhD scientists and engineers – collaborating across disciplines to both build better software and deliver a better service. You will bring a designer's perspective to questions that today get answered through a technical or operational lens, and we believe that will make the product meaningfully better.
 



  





 The people using our product make recommendations and operational decisions every day that affect our clients’ ships across the globe, the people onboard those ships, and the ships’ fuel consumption and emissions. In figuring out how a workflow should feel, where complexity should live, and how to make the right thing the obvious thing for a busy vessel officer, we believe great design makes our product more impactful – and we are looking for someone who agrees.
 



  





 The position is based in Stockholm and travel will be required from time to time. Hybrid work is offered, with access to an inviting office in central Stockholm for interacting with colleagues, as well as the possibility to work some days per week remotely or based on specific agreement.
 



  





 We offer a range of benefits that strengthen your health and well-being, safety and career development, while we value flexibility and community.
 



  





**What you will be doing** 



* Actively contribute to shaping product direction – bringing ideas and opportunities to the table that go beyond the current roadmap.
* Move fluidly between discovery and delivery – from facilitating early conversations around a product concept to ensuring it ships correctly.
* Get close to how we work – spend time with our center operators, join customer calls and occasionally visit vessels or customer offices to understand workflows in real depth.
* Turn ideas into sketches, wireframes and prototypes fast enough to drive the conversation that same week, enabling the team to test and refine concepts before they're built.
* Take ownership of UX and visual quality across the product – not just within individual features, but as an ongoing responsibility.
* Take the opportunity to establish the design system, component library and tooling that fit your needs and the team's.
* Produce design specifications and assets that give our development team what they need to implement features correctly, and stay involved through to shipped feature.
* Occasionally lend your eye and ideas to sales and communications material.



  





**Who you are** 



* You have spent several years working on complex B2B or internal-facing software products. You pair that experience with real curiosity: you want to understand a problem and the people behind it deeply, then help the team build something better.
* You are comfortable moving between discovery and delivery: facilitating a product discussion one day, building a prototype the next, reviewing implementation details with engineers the day after.
* You are self-sufficient and proactive. You thrive as the sole designer in a team of people with deep and complementary expertise, you spot opportunities to improve things before anyone asks, and you follow through.
* You have strong opinions on UX quality – grounded in reasoning and evidence rather than trends or rules – and you can articulate and stand behind your reasoning.
* You have great communication skills and are fluent in English.
* You don’t need to tick every box above. If this role resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.



  





**Your application** 




 If you have questions about the role before applying, feel free to reach out to Pelle Regener (Head of Product) at pelle.regener@oversea.global. We would love to hear from you!

 Head of Product Pelle Regener, pelle.regener@oversea.global 
 



 HR Business Partner Eva Wiberg, eva.wiberg@walleniusmarine.com or
 



 Union representative Unionen Torbjörn Edvall, torbjorn.edvall@soyagroup.com
 



  





 As we have already decided on the recruitment channels we wish to use, we kindly decline to be contacted for further offers of recruitment, advertising, or recruitment assistance.
 



  





**About the workplace** 




 Turning data into insights – and insights into actions
 



 At Oversea, we turn vessel data into smarter decisions at sea and on shore. We unite digital innovation and maritime expertise to deliver actionable, impactful insights and support.  Data-driven. Human-led. A new way of working. 
 



 Oversea offers Fleet Support Center as a Service – a unique decision-support solution combining advanced analytics with hands-on expertise from our maritime center specialists. We support customers in navigating complex operations and transforming insights into real operational value.

Your work contributes directly to lower emissions, and more efficient fleet operations. You’ll work closely with colleagues across different countries and disciplines, learning from one another as you go.
 



  





 Grow in a human-centric, knowledge-driven environment
 



 We know that people grow when they’re trusted, supported and encouraged to explore. That’s why we promote continuous learning, knowledge sharing and collaboration. Here, you’ll help shape a smarter and more sustainable future for shipping – powered by human insight. If you want to be part of a pioneering team that blends technology and maritime expertise for the benefit of the maritime sector – Oversea is the place to grow.
 



  





 We are looking for highly skilled, driven and passionate people that will form the core of the company. We want to create a workplace that is open and welcoming, celebrating individuals and differences, and we believe that diversity of thought, background, and experience makes us stronger. We therefore have the clear goal of driving diversity and inclusion across all dimensions: gender, LGBTQ, abilities, ethnicity, and generations.
 



  





 Strong owners
 



 We are owned by ABB and Wallenius Marine — a partnership that gives us both technological muscle and deep maritime roots. It’s a combination that lets us think long-term, innovate with confidence and stay close to the real needs of the industry.

title: Senior Industrial Designer (ICT)
description:
**About the Position** 




 Join a highly creative, multidisciplinary, and international design team dedicated to transforming strategic ideas into innovative and successful products.
 



  





 The team focuses on the design of next-generation ICT equipment and connected products, including telecommunications equipment, indoor and outdoor small cells, smart home devices, intelligent automotive solutions, and other connected technologies.
 



  





 In this role, you will contribute throughout the entire design process, from user research and concept development to prototyping and final product realisation. Drawing on insights from user behaviour, design trends, societal shifts, and emerging business opportunities, you will create compelling design concepts, engaging user experiences, and innovative product features.
 



  





 We are looking for someone with a strong sense of form, colour, materials, and finishes, combined with the ability to articulate the thinking behind their design decisions. You are not simply focused on aesthetics, but are driven by a desire to create meaningful, user-centred solutions with exceptional attention to detail.
 



  





 You understand the importance of design in building strong brands and cohesive product portfolios. You are comfortable communicating ideas through sketching, 3D modelling, prototyping, and visualisation, and enjoy collaborating with designers, engineers, and business stakeholders throughout the development process.
 



  





 You are also confident presenting design concepts, facilitating workshops, providing constructive feedback, and helping multidisciplinary teams navigate the design journey from initial idea to final solution.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Be part of a creative industrial design team developing innovative products.
 



 • Contribute to product development from initial research and concept creation through to successful product realisation.
 



 • Communicate ideas and design concepts effectively to designers, engineers, and management.
 



 • Take responsibility for the industrial design function within multidisciplinary project teams.
 



 • Maintain a strong understanding of competitors, industry developments, emerging technologies, and design trends.
 



  





**Qualifications & Experience** 




 • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Design, Design Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
 



 • Minimum 6-8 years of professional industrial design experience, with significant experience gained in a consultancy, design agency, or design studio environment.
 



 • Proven experience working on projects involving multiple designers while remaining actively engaged in hands-on design work.
 



 • Excellent understanding of form, proportions, colour, materials, and finishes (CMF).
 



 • Strong awareness of global design, technology, and consumer trends.
 



 • Knowledge of manufacturing processes and materials.
 



 • Hands-on experience with model making, prototyping, and testing.
 



 • Proficiency in Creo, Rhino, KeyShot, Adobe Creative Suite, or equivalent design tools.
 



 • Self-driven, well-organised, and capable of independently managing design activities.
 



 • Proven experience delivering successful industrial design projects in an international environment.
 



 • Experience designing consumer products is considered an advantage.
 



  





**Required Skills & Personal Characteristics** 




 • A strong portfolio demonstrating creativity, innovation, and successful product development.
 



 • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders.
 



 • A passion for creating meaningful products and exceptional user experiences.
 



 • A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary and international teams.
 



 • Curious, proactive, detail-oriented, and driven by continuous learning and innovation.
 



  





 If you are passionate about creating innovative products and shaping meaningful user experiences through design, we look forward to receiving your application and portfolio by 14 September.
 



  





**As this is an on-site role, relocation to the Stockholm area is required for candidates currently living elsewhere.** 




**This is a full-time consultant position.** 




**Please contact Karin Persson if you have any questions.**

title: Interim Product Designer
description:
**Om Carla**
 Vi bygger det tryggaste, enklaste och mest transparenta sättet att köpa och sälja begagnade bilar – från inköp till kundens uppfart – så att fler kan köra elbil.
   

  

 Carla grundades 2020 i Stockholm. I dag är vi drygt 250 personer, en av Sveriges fem största begagnathandlare och tar snabbt marknadsandelar. Verdane och Bonnier Ventures finns bland våra investerare.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en vass Product Designer för ett nio månader långt vikariat. Du blir en del av vårt Tech & Product-team, rapporterar till CPTO Peter Simon och arbetar med produkt, design och ett tiotal utvecklare i två tvärfunktionella team.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Nästan alla våra system är egenbyggda eftersom värdering, inköp, verkstad, logistik, finansiering och försäljning måste fungera som en sammanhängande kedja. Du designar därför hela affären och inte bara det som händer på skärmen.
   

  

 Ditt uppdrag är att förstå vad användarna behöver innan någon börjar bygga: vem som behöver vilken information, när den behövs och vad som händer när ett steg i flödet inte fungerar.
   

  

 Du designar för tre delar av verksamheten:
   

  

* Interna verktyg: I Kungsängen följer du rekondare, tekniker och bilrangerare som arbetar med händerna fulla och tiden emot sig. Du omvandlar deras vardag till smartare flöden i vårt egenbyggda BackOffice, där bra design sparar både tid och pengar.
* Kommersiella processer: I Vasastan arbetar du nära värdering, inköp, sälj och support. Du designar resan från kundens första beskrivning till värdering, inköp och lagd order – utan att information tappas mellan människor och system.
* Kundupplevelsen: Du utvecklar våra digitala kundflöden, men rollen är bredare än klassisk e-handelsdesign. Du formar hela kedjan bakom hur Carla köper in, förädlar och säljer bilar.


 Olika användare, ofta under samma vecka – och med direkt påverkan på både kundupplevelsen och affären.
   

  

**Ditt ansvar**
* Driva discovery och service design nära verksamheten.
* Genomföra användarintervjuer och omvandla insikter till tydliga problemformuleringar.
* Designa, prototypa, användartesta och iterera lösningar.
* Arbeta nära produktägare, tech lead och utvecklare i teamen Operations och Commercial.
* Planera och prioritera med produktägarna och vid behov din chef. När båda teamen har stora projekt prioriterar vi – du förväntas inte hinna allt.
* Vidareutveckla designsystemet löpande i projekten.
* Använda AI för att effektivisera discovery, prototyping och design.


 Din tid fördelas ungefär på 45 % discovery, 30 % design och användartest, 10 % designsystem och 15 % samarbete mellan teamen men varierar beroende på vad vi har för fokusområden eller projekt.
   

  

**Designverktyg och arbetssätt**
 AI är en naturlig del av vardagen – från att sammanställa intervjuer och identifiera lösbara problem till att skapa klickbara prototyper samma dag och hålla designsystemet uppdaterat.
   

  

 Exakt vilka AI-verktyg du använder är mindre viktigt än ditt omdöme om när de skapar värde och när de i stället kostar tid.
   

  

 I dag använder vi:
   

  

* Figma och FigJam för design, prototyper och workshops
* Notion och Google Docs för dokumentation
* Claude och Claude Design i det AI-assisterade arbetet


**För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att det är bra att:**
* Du har drivit design självständigt och är trygg som Carlas enda designer under nio månader. Du har produktägare, utvecklare och engagerade stakeholders omkring dig, men ingen designer bredvid dig.
* Du är lika nyfiken på verkstadens flöden som på hur en bil värderas. Känns det ena ointressant är rollen inte rätt.
* Du låter gärna produktägare och utvecklare bidra med lösningar. Du sätter riktningen och höjer nivån – ibland på pixelnivå, men inte alltid.
* Du använder AI dagligen och föredrar research som påverkar veckans beslut framför rapporter med möjlig effekt långt senare.
* Du har starkt eget driv och sätter dig snabbt in i nya miljöer och användarbehov.
* Du talar flytande svenska och engelska


**Anställning och arbetsplats**
* Vikariat från mitten av november tom augusti, med uppehåll för sommarsemester. Du börjar innan vår designer går på föräldraledighet den 1 december för att få en ordentlig överlämning
* Det kan finnas chans till förlängning eller en permanent roll, men vi kan inte lova det i dagsläget
* Vi välkomnar även konsulter inom rollens budget. Lön och ersättning går vi igenom i det första samtalet
* Rollen utgår från Stockholm: en till tre dagar i Vasastan, en till två i Kungsängen och resten hemifrån om du vill. Fördelningen varierar med projekten


**Rekryteringsprocessen**
 Skicka ditt CV, portofolio (valfritt) och några rader om varför rollen intresserar dig
   

  

* Alva Labs tester
* Ett 30-minuterssamtal med rekryteraren Sandra Palm.
* Ett samtal med CPTO Peter Simon.
* En case- och portfoliointervju med vår designer och båda produktägarna, där du presenterar ett valfritt eget case.
* Referenser och bakgrundskontroll


 Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Business Operations Associate
description:
**About Us:** 
 At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.
   

  

**Role Overview:** 
 We began by taking hotel bookings online over 20 years ago and we've been shaping the travel industry ever since. Today, we're building a platform that connects all parts of the trip – from accommodation to transport, flights, tickets, tours and much more!
   

  

 Our Trips Business Unit helps people get where they want to go, anywhere in the world. Whether customers want the freedom of a car, the convenience of a flight, the ease of a taxi or the economy of public transport, we make it all possible.
   

  

 Our team is passionate about helping people travel. They see challenges as opportunities. And they're always ready for change.
   

  

 A trip usually starts with a flight. The Flights team's mission is to offer a wide selection of flights, great value for money and the easiest end-to-end booking experience. We partner with our Strategic partner Etraveli Group to make our mission a reality and have ambitious goals over the next years.
   

  

 The Flights Business Operations Associate is primarily responsible for implementing the necessary processes and structure to ensure the department achieves its goals and operates smoothly, effectively, and efficiently.
   

  

 This role involves supporting the execution of day-to-day operations and establishing an effective "rhythm of business" between the Flights Team and our Strategic Partners.
   

  

 You will support all partner facing business operations activities (such as planning, QBRs), and implement and optimize processes for scaling the partnership, aid in measuring and reporting health and performance for business reviews and drive solutions to medium complexity problems in partnership with involved parties
   

  

 The role will report to the Strategic Partnership Operations Manager and be based in a small team in our Stockholm office.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Identify and drive the set-up, kick-off and execution of new/improved business as usual processes between B.com Flights, internal stakeholders and our Strategic Partner
* Support all partner facing activities with our strategic partner
* Own the collection, analysis and action plan for partnership health topics
* Drive process improvements
* Drive change management within the Flights department to adopt new processes and ways of working
* Run medium complexity projects and initiatives related to our Strategic Partner


**Who you are:**
* You have strong operational skills
* You have experience of building and optimising business processes
* You have project management skills
* You are a fast learner
* You have excellent stakeholder management skills
* You are proactive and able to identify process improvements opportunities
* You have good commercial awareness and are able to understand basics of business drivers
* You are comfortable working with teams and stakeholders based in different locations (Amsterdam, Stockholm, London and Athens)
* You are able to work independently and as part of a team
* You are able to summarize complex information in a simple manner
* You have great written and verbal presentation skills
* You have experience of working with an external partner


**Role Qualifications and Requirements:**
**Your experience:**
* Experience in project management
* Experience of process improvements and change management
* Strong stakeholder management skills and experience influencing at management level (up to Director)
* Strong communication skills


**Requirements:**
* The role could require some business travel to our Strategic partner (Sweden - Stockholm, Greece - Athens) around once per quarter.


**Benefits & Perks - Global Impact, Personal Relevance:**
 Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include:
   

  

* Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave
* Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country)
* Industry leading product discounts - up to 1400 per year - for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit


**Inclusion at Booking.com:**
 Inclusion has been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations.
   

  

 Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It’s a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech.”
   

  

 We ensure that colleagues with disabilities are provided the adjustments and tools they need to participate in the job application and interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.
   

  

**Application Process:**
 This section should provide:
   

  

* Let’s go places together: How we Hire
* This role does not come with relocation assistance.


 Booking.com is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We strive to move well beyond traditional equal opportunity and work to create an environment that allows everyone to thrive.
   

  

**Pre-Employment Screening**
*If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.*

title: Business Analyst
description:

title: People Manager - Experience Engineering
description:

title: Area Business Manager People
description:
**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
  

 As Area Business Manager for the People area, you will hold overall business responsibility for how our people processes, services, data and technology capabilities are shaped, prioritised and developed, ensuring they continuously support business needs and create value across the organisation. Working in close co-leadership with the Area Tech Manager, you will connect people, process and technology needs to set a clear direction, develop scalable solutions and deliver measurable business value. You will also have formal people responsibility, leading and developing colleagues in the area while creating the conditions for strong collaboration, ownership and delivery. This is a forward-looking role in an area where we are still shaping the future, with the opportunity to bring a modern, relevant and creative perspective to how people solutions are designed, prioritised and brought to life.
   

  





*You will:*



* Co-lead the People area together with the Area Tech Manager, ensuring clear direction, shared priorities and strong alignment between business and technology.
* Hold overall responsibility for the area’s development and performance, beyond individual transformation initiatives.
* Set a clear direction for how the People area supports colleagues, managers and HR teams across the organisation.
* Turn business and people needs into clear priorities, plans and actions that create value in everyday work.
* Lead improvements across the employee journey, making our people processes, services and tools easier to use, more reliable and more effective.
* Work closely with People, Tech and market teams to connect real business needs with practical solutions that can scale across the organisation.
* Make thoughtful choices on what to focus on first, balancing colleague experience, compliance, capacity, cost and long-term impact.
* Create alignment between different teams and stakeholders, helping them work together towards shared outcomes.
* Ensure the area is run responsibly, with clear ownership of resources, budgets, risks and continuous improvement.
* Lead and develop people in the area through formal people responsibility, creating a collaborative, inclusive and forward-looking environment where teams can do their best work.



**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**




 You will work in close co-leadership with the Area Tech Manager, combining business and technology perspectives to set direction, align priorities and create value across the People area. Together, you will collaborate with the wider Area Tech team and process teams across the People Life Cycle to build simple, scalable and future-ready solutions shaped by real business needs and supporting the full employee journey.
   

  





  

  





**WHO YOU ARE**




 We know that relevant experience can take different forms. What matters is that you understand the complexity of working across people, process and technology, and that you are motivated by building something better in a fast moving environment where priorities can change. You are comfortable stepping into unclear situations, working hands on with others and helping teams move forward even when the full plan is not yet defined.
   

  





***We are looking for people with…***



* Experience from leading change, business development, transformation or product/service delivery within HR, People, shared services or another complex environment.
* Strong understanding of HR processes, employee data, employee lifecycle capabilities and how digital tools can make work easier, more consistent and more effective for colleagues, managers and HR teams.
* The ability to turn business and people needs into clear priorities, practical plans and outcomes that others can understand and act on.
* Financial acumen with experience managing budgets, investments, and resource allocation.
* Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to balance value creation, cost optimization, and ROI.
* Experience working in changing environments where priorities shift, plans evolve and progress depends on close collaboration across different teams.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, including the confidence and perseverance to work through different opinions, competing priorities and difficult conversations.
* Knowledge of governance, risk, compliance and operational excellence in relation to HR data, access, platforms, integrations or global people processes.
* Relevant HR understanding, with the ability to connect people related needs, processes and data to business outcomes.
* A degree within HR, business administration, organisational development, technology or a related field.



***And people who are…***



* Customer-focused and value-driven.
* Collaborative and hands on, with the ability to build strong partnerships while also getting close to the details when needed.
* Able to connect long term ambitions with day-to-day execution, even when the path forward is not fully clear.
* Resilient and persistent, with the energy to keep moving forward through complexity, changing direction and stakeholder challenges.
* Empowering leaders that develop people and create an inclusive environment.
* Curious, innovative, and open to new perspectives.
* Accountable, proactive, and focused on delivering outcomes.
* Clear communicators who can create alignment and engagement across diverse stakeholder groups, especially when priorities are unclear or opinions differ.



**WHO WE ARE**




 H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
   

  





 We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.
   

  





**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**




 At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
   

  





 An example of our benefits:
   

  




* 25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands, both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).
* H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Learn more about the program here.
* With a presence in markets around the world, we offer extensive career development and international mobility.



**JOIN US**




 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.
   

  





 Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.
   

  





*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.*

title: Client Lead
description:
On-site in Stockholm. This is a full-time role based at our office at Skeppsbron 16. It is not remote or hybrid-from-elsewhere, and we are only considering candidates who already live in the Stockholm area and have the right to work in Sweden.
 



  





 About Most Studios
 



  





 Most is a brand consultancy in Stockholm, and we move brands to the forefront of their industries. We don't stop at the strategy, we build it and take it to market, from the first thought to how a customer actually meets the brand. Our clients include IKEA, Klarna, Legora, Tandem Health and GleSYS.
 



  





 As Client Lead you own what happens before the work starts: turning enquiries into signed projects, and keeping them moving.
 



  





 What this role is for
 



  





 You own the process from the moment an enquiry comes in until the project is signed, and you keep it moving. You're the project manager of that process, and you're in it: putting together quotes and proposals, coordinating the pitch, and being in the room when we present.
 



  





 You'll work closely with our senior creative, strategic, and operations team on how we answer a brief. Your focus is holding the whole thing together and making sure it lands.
 



  





 Core responsibilities
 



  





 • Own incoming enquiries and requests. First response, qualification, and setting the direction for how we move forward.
 



 • Act as project manager for the process. Keep things moving, coordinate timelines, and make sure the right people are involved at the right moment.
 



 • Put together quotes and proposals with the team, and coordinate the pitch all the way to the presentation.
 



 • Handle the admin backbone. CRM, scheduling, follow-ups, contracts, the details that keep things from stalling.
 



 • Drive projects to signed. This is a hands-on, doer role. Comfortable following up, chasing the detail, and getting to yes.
 



 • Coordinate closely with the senior creative, strategic, and operations team on concept and scope.
 



 • Build and cultivate relationships with our clients.
 



  





 What we're looking for
 



  





 Someone who has worked as an Account Director, Business Developer, or Project Manager at an agency is a strong profile. That background means you already know how work moves through a creative organisation.
 



  





 Beyond that:
 



  





 • Comfortable with process and admin. Detail-oriented, doesn't let things slip.
 



 • Action-oriented. Doesn't wait for a scope to be perfect before pushing things forward.
 



 • Confident coordinating across a creative team without needing the final say on concept.
 



 • Trustworthy and capable in front of clients, whether you're presenting or supporting.
 



  





 What this role is not
 



  





 • Not an outbound role. You won't be cold-calling or working a room for leads. The work brings enquiries to us. Your job is to make sure none of them is handled slowly or badly.
 



 • Not a strategic decision-maker for the studio's direction.
 



 • Not the person who defines the creative answer to a brief. That's led by the senior creative, strategic and operations team, with you alongside them.
 



  





 This is a mid-level role. What matters more than years is that you've run the mechanics yourself, rather than managed someone who did.
 



  





 What you can expect from us
 



  





 • A beautiful office at Skeppsbron 16, in the middle of Stockholm.
 



 • Competitive salary.
 



 • 4.5% pension on top of your monthly salary.
 



 • Full health insurance, cover for long-term sick leave, and 3,000 SEK a year for health-related expenses.
 



 • Five weeks of vacation.
 



 • A MacBook Pro and an iPhone, with the phone bill covered.
 



 • Parental leave at 90% of salary plus 3,000 SEK a month. Your career doesn't go on hold.
 



 • Courses, seminars and training on us. Your growth is the point.
 



 • Room to move. We promote from within first.
 



  





 How to apply
 



  





 Send a short introduction and your CV to talent@moststudios.com. Tell us about one project you personally carried from first contact to signed.
 



  





 We hire ego-free. Open-minded people who make the room better, from whatever background got them here.

title: Product Developer / Buyer
description:
We are looking for a commercially driven and highly organised Product Developer / Buyer to join our team.
   

  

 In this role, you will have end-to-end responsibility for your assigned product groups — from concept, development and sourcing through buying and final delivery. You will combine product expertise with strong commercial judgement, working closely with Design, Planning, Finance, Production and suppliers to ensure we develop and buy the right products, at the right cost, quality and timing.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Lead the product development process from concept to bulk, ensuring products meet our quality, commercial and technical requirements.
* Plan and manage your projects within the company ETE, ensuring key milestones and deadlines are met. Proactively identify risks or delays, flag when timelines are not workable and propose solutions to keep projects on track.
* Establish target costs during the early development phase and work closely with Design and suppliers to ensure product concepts can be delivered within agreed COGS and margin targets. Challenge construction, materials, specifications and production methods where required to achieve commercial objectives.
* Take responsibility for buying and purchasing within your assigned product groups, including order quantities, purchase orders, delivery dates and purchasing accuracy.
* Work closely with Planning and Finance to analyse sales, forecasts and inventory, ensuring purchasing quantities are optimised and aligned with stock, cash flow and margin targets.
* Manage supplier negotiations and price development, balancing cost, quality, capacity and delivery requirements.
* Source and develop products with our suppliers, managing sampling, approvals, testing and production follow-up.
* Ensure products meet agreed standards for quality, fit, construction, colour and performance before bulk production. Follow up production issues with suppliers and drive corrective actions where required.
* Build strong supplier relationships and continuously identify opportunities to improve cost, quality and delivery performance.
* Ensure accurate product, costing and purchasing data in our PLM and ERP systems.


 Who are you?
   

  

 You are a structured, proactive and commercially minded person who enjoys taking ownership and making things happen. You are comfortable moving between product development and commercial decision-making, and can balance creativity with numbers, deadlines and business priorities.
   

  

 You have:
   

  

* Experience in Product Development, Buying, Sourcing or a combination of these, ideally within fashion, textiles or accessories.
* Strong understanding of product development, manufacturing, costing and purchasing.
* Experience working with international suppliers and negotiating prices.
* A good understanding of forecasting, purchasing quantities, inventory and commercial performance.
* A strong ability to plan, prioritise and manage timelines.
* Excellent communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* A hands-on, collaborative approach and the confidence to challenge when something can be done better.


 This is a role for someone who wants real ownership — from product idea to purchase order, and from cost target to final delivery.
