title: Software Integration Engineer
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.
   

  

*We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions*
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a software integration engineer who can champion the delivery of features in our newest product. This involves working across software and hardware to ensure that the full system is integrated together seamlessly when it needs to be delivered to the customer.
   

  

**At Applied Intuition, You Will**
* Deliver full-system features that span software and hardware that meet customer requirements
* Directly interact with the customers at the customer site to identify the target use-cases, then manage the project to complete the integration
* Work cross-functionally with the product, software, mechanical and electrical teams to develop and deploy systems
* Develop a deep understanding of the entire system architecture and how the software and hardware components interact
* Design and bring up test rigs needed for end-to-end testing and validation of system performance
* Test and troubleshoot integration between various components to ensure reliability


**We're Looking For Someone Who Has**
* 2+ years of experience in software integration or development
* An understanding of electronic systems and how how to setup and debug them
* Experience with developing or testing software applications
* Software development experience in Python or C/C++
* Familiarity with Linux development and Bash scripting


**Nice To Have**
* Experience in the automotive industry and working with automotive technologies including CAN, LIN, Ethernet, Simulink, AUTOSAR, etc
* Experience interacting with customers to deliver projects that meet their requirements
* Experience developing software for large projects (CI/CD, release process, etc)
* Familiarity with developing software for embedded systems
* Skills in other adjacent areas (CAD/3D printing, PCB design, etc)


**Benefits**
* 30 days of paid vacation per year
* Free daily lunch and dinner in the office, plus breakfast, snacks, and drinks
* Supplemental private health insurance (PrivatAccess Silver) — specialist appointments within 7 working days and surgery within 14, plus long-term sickness income insurance, premium waiver insurance, and group life insurance (TGL)
* Occupational pension: 4.5% of salary up to the statutory income ceiling and 30% of salary above it
* 9,360 SEK annual learning & development and 5,615 SEK annual fitness budget
* 25 free Lyra coaching or therapy sessions per year for you and each of your dependents
* Generous parental leave: on top of statutory parental leave


*Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*
*Applied Intuition is an equal opportunity employer and federal contractor or subcontractor. Consequently, the parties agree that, as applicable, they will abide by the requirements of 41 CFR 60-1.4(a), 41 CFR 60-300.5(a) and 41 CFR 60-741.5(a) and that these laws are incorporated herein by reference. These regulations prohibit discrimination against qualified individuals based on their status as protected veterans or individuals with disabilities, and prohibit discrimination against all individuals based on their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin. These regulations require that covered prime contractors and subcontractors take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status or disability. The parties also agree that, as applicable, they will abide by the requirements of Executive Order 13496 (29 CFR Part 471, Appendix A to Subpart A), relating to the notice of employee rights under federal labor laws.*
**FOR US-BASED ROLES:** 
*Applied Intuition is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive application and interview experience to applicants who are disabled veterans and other applicants with disabilities or medical conditions. Reasonable accommodations are available, requesting an accommodation will not affect your candidacy in any way, and you are not required to disclose the nature of your disability or medical condition in order to make a request.*
*If you require an accommodation please contact* 
***careers@applied.co***
*. We will work with you!*

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
**Who are Benifex?** 
 💚💜
   

  

 We are a fast-moving technology company, and
 **one of the most successful providers of online reward and benefits solutions in the world.** 
 We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build
 **workplace technology** 
 that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to
 **build remarkable experiences that employees love.** 
 Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best,
 **we need brilliant people** 
 on board and that’s where you come in. 🚀
   

  

**Why should you apply? 🌟**
* Impact: work on a product suite used by millions of people that improves employee experience and wellbeing.
* Scale: a big focus of our engineering teams is building features and services to support our customers globally.
* Autonomy: have an input into the product roadmap and technically lead features/services.
* Development: this is a crucial part of our aim to ensure a seamless experience across FPS.
* Top 10 Employer, Sunday Times Best Places to Work Awards
* Work for a profitable, fast-growing market leader in the online reward and benefits space


**Role Overview 🚀**
 As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you will work across frontend and backend areas that support Benifex employee experience products, mobile app, and platform look and feel.
   

  

 The team is responsible for operational continuity, technical stability, and continuous improvement beyond the product roadmap, which means the work often involves balancing new development with careful maintenance, refactoring, and production reliability.
   

  

 This role suits someone who enjoys complex domains, established systems, and end-to-end ownership. You will contribute to frontend development in React, TypeScript, and Angular, while also designing and maintaining backend services, APIs, and integrations using Java, Spring/Spring Boot, and SQL.
   

  

 We are also on a journey to use AI more deliberately in our daily engineering work. We are looking for someone who has practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows, or who wants to keep exploring how these tools can help us move faster, improve quality, understand complex codebases, and reduce repetitive work without lowering our engineering standards.
   

  

**Great Benefits**
 🧠 ITP1 pension.
   

  

 ❤️ Lifeplan - a leading financial advisory service that offers personalized advice for maximizing your pension savings.
   

  

 📝 Collective agreement.
   

  

 💸 Access to our comprehensive benefits portal.
   

  

 🤸 Generous wellness allowance.
   

  

 ✈️ 30 vacation days / year.
   

  

 💰 Referral bonuses.
   

  

 🌟 Enhanced parental pay.
   

  

 🙂 Volunteer Days – two paid days annually to give back to the community.
   

  

**Responsibilities 🤘**
* Design, build, and maintain fullstack features across employee experience products and platform UI areas.
* Build frontend functionality in React and TypeScript and support existing Angular-based applications.
* Develop and maintain backend services, APIs, and data flows using Java, Spring/Spring Boot, and SQL.
* Integrate frontend experiences with reliable, well-designed APIs and platform services.
* Safely evolve a large, long-lived codebase through incremental refactoring and technical debt reduction.
* Treat reliability, security, performance, accessibility, and maintainability as core parts of delivery.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, documentation, and knowledge-sharing.
* Help investigate bugs and production issues, identify root causes, and prevent recurring problems.
* Mentor other engineers and contribute to technical decisions within the team.
* Use AI-assisted and agentic coding tools thoughtfully as part of daily development, code exploration, testing, refactoring, and documentation.
* Help the team learn where AI adds value, where human judgement is still essential, and how to use these tools responsibly in a complex production codebase.


**What are we looking for? 🔎**
* Java, Spring/Spring Boot, and SQL: Needed to build and maintain backend services, APIs, and data-driven functionality.
* React, TypeScript, and Angular: Needed to contribute across both future frontend development and existing FPS frontend areas.
* API design and integration: Important for creating dependable interfaces between frontend, backend, and platform services.
* Testing, CI/CD, and observability: Needed to deliver reliable changes and diagnose issues in production-like environments.
* AI-assisted and agentic coding: Practical experience using AI coding tools to explore codebases, generate or refactor code, write tests, support reviews, or accelerate delivery while maintaining strong engineering judgement.


**Please note:** 
 Our recruitment process will begin in mid-to-late August, once the hiring team has returned from their summer holidays. We appreciate your patience and look forward to reviewing your application.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving and reading your application!
   

  

**Our Interview Process ✌**
 Benifex understand the need to have a fast and efficient process, the below will all be completed in the shortest time possible, typically a 2-2.5 week timeframe.
   

  

 📞 Initial informal call with the Talent team
   

  

 ⏳ Interview with our Engineering Director 30-45 min
   

  

 🧪 Technical Task
   

  

 🔎 Technical Interview - 60 min
   

  

 🤩 Final interview with VP of Engineering - 30-45 min
   

  

  

  

**We are a proud member of the Disability Confident employer scheme.**
**If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage during the recruitment process, please let us know with your application.**

title: Offer Specialist C&SP
description:
We are looking for an Offer Specialist for Cloud & Service Providers to drive our Digital Energy positioning in the data center segment. This is a high-impact, exposed role operating at the intersection of technology, commercial strategy, and cross-functional coordination. You will work across multiple internal and external stakeholders to shape and position integrated solutions for some of the most demanding and technically advanced customers in the market. This is a unique opportunity to shape how we bring next-generation energy and automation solutions to the market.
   

  

**What you will do:**
**Drive Technical Solution Positioning**
* Shape and position integrated solutions for our data center clients across:
+ Building Management Systems (BMS / automation)
+ Energy & Power Management (EPMS / PMS)
+ Monitoring, metering, and field devices

* Contribute to the development of software-driven, integrated offers
* Support the transition toward open, interoperable platforms (integration, data, and scalability)


**Lead Value-Based Customer Engagement**
* Translate technical capabilities into clear customer value (efficiency, uptime, performance, scalability)
* Engage confidently with highly technical data center customers
* Support commercial discussions with a consultative, solution-oriented approach


**Orchestrate Cross-Functional Collaboration**
* Work across a complex stakeholder landscape, including Sales and Account Managers, Solution Architects, Internal Secure Power teams, Global account organizations, as well as Execution and delivery teams
* Align stakeholders to build and deliver winning offers
* Navigate a matrix organization and drive outcomes without direct authority


**Qualifications**
* With a strong technical background, you have a solid understanding of:
+ Automation / Building Management Systems (BMS/BAS)
+ Energy & Power Monitoring systems (EPMS / PMS)

* Knowledge of field-level infrastructure (sensors, metering, controls)
* Exposure to data center environments or critical infrastructure is highly valued
* Fluent in Swedish and English


**What You Bring**
* Ability to clearly articulate value beyond technical features, translating solutions into customer-relevant benefits
* Confidence in customer-facing discussions, with the ability to support or lead solution positioning and offers
* Experience collaborating across multiple teams and functions to drive alignment and outcomes
* Ability to quickly understand, navigate, and operate effectively within matrixed environments while steering through pressure.
* A technically grounded profile with clear commercial potential and business awareness
* A collaborative, proactive approach with a focus on driving results


**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunities for professional development and career progression

 €40 billion global revenue
   

  

 +9% organic growth
   

  

 150 000+ employees in 100+ countries

title: Internship as AI Solutions Engineer for FICC Markets | SEB, Stockholm
description:
FICC Markets has initiated an ambitious AI transformation program, aimed at building and integrating AI capabilities in our business.
   

  

 To help us achieve this goal, we are opening an internship position for a talented AI Solutions engineers for a period of 6-9 months. You will be part of the FICC Data and Analytics team reporting to Head of Risk Management. We favour full time employment for the length of the contract but may be flexible with part time employment.
   

  

 Your role:
   

  

* Design and implement AI solutions for Trading and Sales. These can involve machine learning, generative AI and agents.
* Work on AI foundations including data modelling and data platform
* Develop FICC business / quant analytics which can be used by AI agents
* Be an AI champion in the organization and spread knowledge on AI
* Participate in setting the overall AI strategy


 Your profile:
   

  

* Some relevant work experience
* Strong quantitative background with solid knowledge in ML and programming as well as some experience of working with GenAI.
* Analytical thinking
* Good programming skills in Python, a plus to have worked with Cloud infrastructure
* Interest for financial markets. Knowledge of financial instruments and derivatives pricing a plus.
* Innovative, curious and ready to take initiatives.
* Deliver on objectives

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
**Build something monumental for Healthcare!**
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
   

  

 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
   

  

**About The Role**
 You’ve never been satisfied with just delivering the number. You start by understanding the decision a team is trying to make, then work backwards to the question and evidence they actually need. You earn your seat in the room by making decisions better and helping teams make the next one themselves, whether through a trusted metric, a clearer model, or a self-serve workflow.
   

  

 As an
 **Analytics Engineer** 
 at Tandem you'll own the data layer that the rest of the company runs on - the dbt models, the metrics, the semantic definitions and you'll sit close to the teams that use it. Product deciding what to build next. Clinical ops working out how we serve customers. Commercial and finance running the business. You'll work embedded with them rather than behind a request queue, and you'll be expected to have a point of view and argue it.
   

  

 We are a small but growing data team. It is still early enough that everyone contributes across the full scope of the data team's work. As we grow, this role will likely specialise - likely toward either the product side or the commercial side - and we're open to which of those pulls at you.
   

  

****What You Will Do****
* Turn the questions people bring you into clear, trustworthy answers, delivered in the form and channel they will actually use. Work with stakeholders to see whether the answer was understood, acted on, and changed the decision it was meant to inform.
* Build self-serve surfaces and documentation that help teams answer their own questions and act on what they find.
* Own and evolve the data layer - dbt models, metrics, and semantic definitions - so that the answers built on it are trustworthy and easy to reach for.
* Proactively surface what the data shows - patterns, risks, and opportunities nobody asked about.
* Ensure data and metric quality through testing, monitoring, and clear ownership of the datasets you produce.
* Bring the analytics perspective into data platform decisions: what data, tools, and capabilities we invest in next - and help build them.


****What You Bring****
* Excellent SQL skills.
* Experience in analytics engineering, data analytics, data engineering or a closely related field.
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining a modeling layer in production - dbt or equivalent - including testing and documentation.
* A genuinely business-minded approach: you understand what the teams you support are trying to achieve, and you push back when the question they asked isn't the question they need answered.
* Strong communication skills - you can present to a room, explain a method to a non-technical stakeholder, and argue your point without winning by jargon.
* A sense of ownership that extends past delivery: you care whether the work landed.


**Bonus Points**
* Python for analysis, scripting, and lightweight tooling.
* Experience working embedded with product, commercial, or finance teams.
* Experience in healthtech, or in another regulated environment handling sensitive data.
* Experience in early-stage startups or scaleups, where you've built things from close to zero.


**Location**
 We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our vibrant HQ in the heart of Stockholm where you will work primarily from our office to collaborate, connect, and build our culture.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.
   

  

 Our interview process consists of 4 stages:
   

  

* Screening interview with Talent Acquisition
* Interview with a member of the Data team
* Technical discussion and interview with a member of the Data team and our Head of Data
* Case presentation at our office - join us in Stockholm for a case and a lunch with the team, to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with us, and see how you work in action


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary & company stock options
* 30 days/year of paid vacation
* Pension
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag)
* Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)
* An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare
* Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering


 We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.
   

  

**Culture at Tandem**
 At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.
   

  

 Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.
   

  

 Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.
   

  

 We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.
   

  

*Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.*

title: Commercial Operations Manager
description:
*While we welcome applications from everywhere, please note that at this stage we are prioritizing candidates who are* 
***already based in the Stockholm area***
*and* 
***eligible to work in Sweden without visa sponsorship.***




 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 



  





**We are Bambuser, and we're reshaping commerce.** 




  





 Video has quickly become one of the most powerful ways for brands to engage, inspire and convert consumers.
 



 At Bambuser, we're helping some of the world's most recognized brands transform how they sell online through
 **live shopping, shoppable video** 
 and interactive commerce experiences. Brands like
 **LVMH** 
 ,
 **Audi** 
 ,
 **Sephora** 
 ,
 **Decathlon** 
 and
 **Sonos** 
 use our platform to create richer, more engaging customer experiences.
 



  





 But building great products is only part of the equation.
 



  





 Behind every customer relationship is a complex journey involving
 **contracts, procurement processes, subscriptions, billing, renewals** 
 and
 **commercial operations** 
 . As we grow, ensuring those journeys run smoothly becomes increasingly important.
 



  





*That's where you come in, as our new* 
***Commercial Operations Manager.***




  





 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




  





**The Challenge** 




  





 At Bambuser, closing a deal is only the beginning.
 



  





 Our customers are global brands with complex procurement requirements, contract negotiations, subscription agreements and billing processes. Turning a signed agreement into successful revenue realization requires coordination across Sales, Customer Success, Finance and the customer themselves.
 



  





 Over the last five years, we've built a strong
 **Quote-to-Cash** 
 foundation. Now we're looking for someone to take ownership of it, improve it and help shape what comes next.
 



 You'll inherit processes that work. Your challenge is to make them more scalable, more efficient and better connected through systems, automation and operational excellence.
 



  





 You'll also sit closer than almost anyone to the realities of our customers. You'll see where deals slow down, where procurement becomes a blocker, where customers challenge value, and where operational friction impacts revenue.
 



  





 If you enjoy bringing order to complexity, solving commercial problems and improving how businesses operate, you'll thrive in this role.
 



  





  





**What You'll Own** 




  






 Commercial & Quote-to-Cash Operations
 



* Own the operational journey from signed agreement to billing handover.
* Manage contracts, renewals, amendments and subscription changes.
* Support contract negotiations and redlining processes.
* Coordinate customer procurement and purchase order requirements.
* Ensure billing readiness and commercial accuracy.
* Resolve customer-facing operational, contractual and billing-related queries.
* Partner with Sales, Customer Success and Finance to keep revenue moving efficiently.'



  






 Salesforce & Revenue Systems
 



* Own Salesforce as the commercial source of truth.
* Drive CRM adoption, data quality and process governance.
* Build reporting, visibility and workflows that help teams make better decisions.
* Ensure our systems scale with the business.



  






 Revenue Operations & Business Improvement
 



* Use systems, automation and AI to create leverage across the revenue organization.
* Surface insights that improve customer experience, retention and revenue realization.
* Turn operational complexity into scalable ways of working.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  






 Required
 



* Experience working in a SaaS or subscription-based business.
* Strong understanding of Quote-to-Cash processes.
* Experience managing contracts, subscriptions and recurring revenue operations.
* Strong Salesforce knowledge and confidence acting as a CRM super user.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work cross-functionally across Sales, Customer Success and Finance.
* Fluent English.



  






 Nice to Have
 



* Experience supporting enterprise customers and procurement processes.
* Experience with contract negotiations and redlining.
* Experience with workflow automation and process improvement.
* Experience working with AI tools and automation initiatives.
* Experience with subscription billing, ERP or Revenue Operations platforms.



  





 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 



  





**ABOUT THE TEAM** 




  





 This role sits in Sales, Customer Success and Finance.
 



 You'll partner with commercial teams to support customer agreements, renewals, procurement processes and operational challenges. You'll also work alongside Finance to ensure revenue moves smoothly from contract signature through billing and collection.
 



 As Bambuser continues investing in automation and AI, you'll collaborate with our Operations Architect and leadership team to identify where technology can create real leverage, so our people spend more time on the work that makes them exceptional.
 



 This role offers a unique opportunity to influence how revenue operations evolves at Bambuser and how our commercial teams scale in the years ahead.
 



  





 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 



  





**Why this role at Bambuser?**




 Video commerce is taking off, and we're looking for brilliant people to join our tight-knit and ambitious team as we go after a massive opportunity and establish Bambuser as the reference in the space.
 



 As our
 **Commercial Operations Manager,** 
 you'll have a horizontal view of the entire revenue engine, a direct line to senior leadership, and the opportunity to shape how the core of our business operates together.
 



 This is a unique opportunity to join a high-growth environment and work on some of the highest-impact challenges in the company. You'll not only shape systems and processes, but raise the ceiling for the people around you by removing friction, creating clarity and enabling them to spend more time doing what makes them exceptional.
 



 If you get energy from making teams more effective, solving complex operational challenges and building the foundations that help a company scale, you’re going to love it here.

title: Trade & Logistics konsult (hybrid)
description:

 på nytt – skicka oss din ansökan som
   

  

 Trade & Logistics konsult

* Som konsult inom vårt område Trade & Logistics blir din viktigaste uppgift att hjälpa våra kunder inom handel och logistik att förbättra och utveckla sina affärsprocesser. Du kommer vara delaktig i projekt som rör både införande av nya affärssystem och löpande förbättringsarbete. Du skapar värde för kunden genom din förståelse för kundens verksamhet och förmåga att vägleda dem till processförbättringar som möjliggörs med affärssystemet Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
* Våra arbetsformer innebär att du ibland arbetar i ett större projektteam och ibland möter kunden själv. Viss del av arbetet görs på något av våra kontor och viss del av arbetet görs ute hos våra kunder. Detta innebär att tjänsten kan innebära en del resor beroende på kund och projekt. Möjligheten finns även att få delta i internationella projekt.
* Arbetet som konsult är otroligt spännande och varierande - och du kommer snabbt att se att det arbete du utför skapar resultat hos kunderna. Hos oss på COSMO CONSULT kommer du få möjligheter att arbeta tillsammans med flera av Sveriges mest erfarna och kompetenta BC/NAV-kollegor. För oss är teamwork en självklarhet, och vi hjälper varandra att kontinuerligt förbättras.


 Du har erfarenhet av:
   

  

* Relevant utbildning från högskola eller universitet och flera års kvalificerad erfarenhet från tillverkande industri, antingen som ledare i linjebefattning eller som affärssystemkonsult.
* Flera års erfarenhet från implementationer av Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central/Dynamics NAV eller annat relevant affärssystem, som konsult alternativt som superanvändare på kundsidan. Ett plus är om du har erfarenhet av att jobba i projekt med Azure DevOps. Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.
* Vi söker dig som är en förtroendeingivande representant för COSMO CONSULT. Du har ett starkt kundfokus och slutför alltid de uppdrag som du påbörjat. Det är även viktigt att du är ansvarstagande och kan driva din egen utveckling mot uppsatta mål, även om vi alltid finns där som stöd. För att passa in i vårt team tror vi att du trivs med att arbeta som en del i en projektgrupp likväl som att utföra uppdrag på egen hand. Som lagspelare har du en stark vilja att dela med dig av din kunskap till andra samt visar andra respekt och omtanke. Utifrån senioritetsnivå bidrar du även till egen beläggning samt deltar i varierande omfattning i marknadsbearbetning hos befintliga och nya kunder


 Lika lika och unika.
   

  

 Det är det som skiljer oss åt:
   

  

* Hos oss är alla en del av teamet - din röst behövs, även när det gäller vår egen företagsutveckling.
* Det är viktigt för oss att du känner dig uppskattad och sedd.
* Platsoberoende och flexibelt arbete är en självklarhet för oss. I rollen ingår det att kontinuerligt besöka något av våra kontor runt om i Sverige: Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö och Umeå.
* Internationellt samarbete är en del av vår vardag - upptäck andra kulturer och nya miljöer.
* En säker och positiv arbetsmiljö är vår högsta prioritet.
* Förändring är en del av oss, och det är därför vi aldrig står stilla utan alltid utvecklas.
* Det ligger oss varmt om hjärtat att tillsammans med dig forma din vidareutveckling.
* Hos oss kan du följa din personliga karriärsväg.
* Vi tar vårt del av ansvaret för människor och miljö på allvar.


 Do you want to become part of the team?
   

  

 Apply directly online with your informative application documents and your earliest possible start date.
   

  

 Do you want more #insideCOSMO?

title: Objektledare
description:
Vi söker nu en kollega som vill göra skillnad i en verksamhet där ditt arbete påverkar på riktigt.
   

  





 Vill du arbeta med förvaltning och utveckling av IT-tjänster som har stor betydelse för hälso- och sjukvården i Region Stockholm? Trivs du med att skapa struktur, samordna människor och leverantörer och tillsammans med andra utveckla stabila och välfungerande tjänster? Då är detta något för dig.
   

  





**Om tjänsten**




 Hos oss blir du en del av ett kompetent team där vi löser uppgiften tillsammans. Vi erbjuder ett arbete med tydlig samhällsnytta i en organisation som genomgår en omfattande digital utveckling. Här finner du kompetenta och engagerade kollegor med olika specialistområden.
   

  





 Som objektledare ansvarar du för att hålla ihop förvaltning och utveckling av flera verksamhetskritiska IT-tjänster. Tjänsterna används inom Region Stockholms hälso- och sjukvård och behöver vara stabila, säkra och utvecklas i takt med verksamhetens behov.
   

  





**Exempel på rollens innehåll:** 



* **Ledning och samordning:** 
 Hålla ihop objektets arbete och tillsammans med objektledare IT, delobjektledare och team skapa tydliga prioriteringar och en gemensam riktning.
* **Ekonomi och planering:** 
 Planera och följa upp objektets budget, prognoser och resursbehov tillsammans med relevanta stödfunktioner och övriga i objektledningen.
* **Leverantörssamverkan:** 
 Ha en aktiv dialog med externa leverantörer, följa upp leveranser och avtal och bidra till att samarbetet fungerar väl.
* **Förvaltning och utveckling:** 
 Planera och prioritera objektets förvaltning och vidareutveckling utifrån verksamhetens behov, tekniska förutsättningar och tillgängliga resurser.
* **Stabilitet och kontinuitet:** 
 Tillsammans med teamet bidra till att tjänsterna är tillgängliga, säkra och robusta samt att det finns fungerande arbetssätt för incidenter och kontinuitet.
* **Samverkan:** 
 Representera objektet i olika forum och skapa goda relationer mellan verksamhet, IT, leverantörer och andra intressenter.



**Vem är du?**




 Vi ser att du tycker om att få människor och olika perspektiv att mötas och att du är bra på att skapa struktur och framdrift.
   

  





 Som person är du kommunikativ och samarbetsinriktad och känner dig bekväm med att ta ansvar och fatta beslut. Du är nyfiken, har förmåga att sätta dig in i nya frågor och vet när du behöver ta hjälp av andra kompetenser.
   

  





 Vi vill att du har: 
 


* Erfarenhet av att leda, samordna eller driva arbete inom IT-förvaltning, IT-leverans, projekt eller liknande.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med planering, prioritering och uppföljning av ekonomi eller resurser.
* Erfarenhet av samarbete med externa leverantörer och/eller avtalsuppföljning.
* Förståelse för strukturerad IT-förvaltning och exempelvis pm3, ITIL eller motsvarande arbetssätt.
* Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning eller annan erfarenhet som vi bedömer som likvärdig.



 Vidare har du mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska samt god förmåga att kommunicera på engelska.
   

  





 Det är meriterande om du har: 
 


* Erfarenhet av verksamhetskritiska IT-tjänster, gärna inom hälso- och sjukvård eller offentlig verksamhet.
* Kunskap om informationssäkerhet, dataskydd eller regelverk som är relevanta för vård-IT.
* Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt eller DevOps.
* Erfarenhet av förändringsarbete i en större organisation.



**Vårt erbjudande**




 Vi har kollektivavtal och med det följer kollektivavtalade försäkringar, tjänstepension och möjlighet till löneväxling. För att du ska kunna ta ansvar för din hälsa erbjuder vi friskvårdstimme och friskvårdsbidrag samt subventionerad sjukvård i form av kostnadsfri öppensjukvård. Flexibel arbetstid och möjlighet till att arbeta hemifrån har vi för att underlätta för dig att få ihop vardagen. Här kan du läsa mer om förmånerna i vårt kollektivavtal.
   

  





 Vi sitter i trevliga lokaler på Lindhagensgatan 98. Hit tar du dig enkelt med tunnelbanans gröna eller blå linje samt med flera busslinjer.
   

  





**Ansökan**




 Låter det här som något för dig ser vi gärna att du söker så snart som möjligt. För en komplett ansökan räcker det med att bifoga ditt CV. När du ansöker kommer du att få besvara ett antal frågor, dessa ersätter personligt brev.
   

  





 I denna rekrytering samarbetar Region Stockholm med Computer Sweden Recruitment. Vid intresse eller frågor kontakta Linda Wallin, Rekryteringskonsult på 0709 20 00 88, linda.wallin@csrecruitment.se
   

  





 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!
   

  





**Övrigt**




 Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas. Som ett andra steg i rekryteringsprocessen ingår webbaserade tester. Vi använder oss av Assessios tester MAP och Matrigma. MAP är en personlighetstest och Matrigma är ett problemlösningstest som båda bygger på arbetspsykologisk forskning. Testerna används som ett komplement till dina erfarenheter och kompetenser. 
   

  





 Hälso- och sjukvårdsförvaltningen stödjer Region Stockholms politiska organisation för att invånarna i Stockholms län har tillgång till en god och säker hälso- och sjukvård samt tandvård. Det innebär att förvaltningen beställer och följer upp hälso- och sjukvård och tandvård för 75 miljarder kronor årligen. Förvaltningen ansvarar också för kunskapsstyrningsorganisationen i Region Stockholm, samt en rad funktioner som är avgörande för hälso- och sjukvårdssystemet, såsom smittskydd, vårdhygien. Läs mer här
   

  





****Att söka jobb i Region Stockholm****




 Vi eftersträvar jämställdhet och jämlikhet på vår arbetsplats och ser gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och förutsättningar.
   

  





 Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via detta system. Ansök genom att klicka på knappen ”Ansök”. Ansökningar per brev eller e-post beaktas inte. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.
   

  





 Vårt rekryteringssystem kan inte hantera anonyma ansökningar eller sökande med skyddade personuppgifter. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta den kontaktpersonen som finns angiven i annonsen. Din ansökan kommer då att hanteras utanför rekryteringssystemet. Du bör även vara försiktig med vilken information du lämnar i din ansökan och endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.
   

  





 Region Stockholm ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och bidrar till kulturlivet. Varje dag, dygnet runt. I landets snabbaste växande region. Tillsammans skapar vi Europas attraktivaste storstadsregion.

title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Browser Control Platform
description:
**Why Mozilla?**



Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.



The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute **open-source** software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.


**About this team and role:**



This role owns the foundation that lets other software drive Firefox: the secure, reliable connection an outside tool or another team uses to act inside the browser, and the building blocks they call to do it. It enables the teams building on it — internal teams, outside AI tools — to create their own products on top. This role owns the shared layer and the strategy for it. It’s a hands-on, technical role in a fast-moving, greenfield space, so it’s as much strategy as execution.



The opportunity is broad: internal teams (Smart Window, New Products’ automated tools), outside AI tools and their users, and web developers. The three share much of the underlying technology, but each reaches its market in a different way. The mandate is to figure out what to go after, and in what order.


**What you’ll do:**
* Own the shared foundation and the building blocks it gives other software, and make them reliable and secure.
* Push the open standard (WebDriver BiDi) forward, and build Firefox-only advantages the standard won’t cover
* Design the safety controls: let a person approve actions, see when software is acting for them, and take back control.
* Define the strategy for any major third-party AI assistants people already use.
* Serve internal teams (Smart Window, New Products) and outside tools through one shared layer.

**Measured on:**

Adoption across teams and tools, volume of usage through the platform, and sustained reliability and security.


**What you'll bring:**
* A product-minded engineer, or a very technical PM who can drive a technical product
* Developer-space experience, with the range to think about consumers and internal platforms
* Comfortable setting strategy in ambiguity; own a technical contract other teams depend on
* Strong instincts on security and trust. Nice to have: web standards, MCP, browser automation


**What you’ll get:**


* Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
* Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
* Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
* Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
* One-time home office stipend
* Annual professional development budget
* Quarterly well-being stipend
* Considerable paid parental leave
* Employee referral bonus program
* Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)


**About Mozilla**



Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.


**Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging**



Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.



We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.

title: Aerodynamics engineer
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**


Join our R&D team as an Aerodynamics Engineer and help shape the future of energy technology by designing highly efficient and reliable turbomachinery components. You will drive innovation in compressor aerodynamics, contributing throughout the entire development process—from initial concept and CFD simulations to validation and long-term product support. Every day, you will deliver solutions that enhance performance and sustainability, ensuring our products meet the highest standards of efficiency and robustness. Step into a role where your work directly impacts the energy transition and the reliability of tomorrow’s power generation.

**How You will Make an Impact**

* Contribute to the aerodynamic design of high-performance turbomachinery compressors using advanced numerical tools, including both in-house and commercial software.
* Perform CFD calculations and analyses on compressors and related components, such as intake houses, flow cavities, and bearing houses, utilizing tools like ANSYS CFX, StarCCM+ and TRACE.
* Implement and develop optimization tools and new methods to enhance R&D efficiency in line with Siemens Energy’s vision.
* Build a local and global network by collaborating with colleagues across Europe, North America, and Asia, and work closely with teams in Aero mechanics, Mechanical Design, Mechanical Integrity, Test, and Manufacturing.

**What You Bring**

* You hold a Master’s or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Engineering Physics, or a related field.
* You have knowledge and interest in fluid dynamics, both theoretical and experimental, mathematics, and programming as well as an experimental background.
* You are highly motivated, passionate, and approach challenges with a problem-solving mindset.
* You thrive in a collaborative team environment and actively contribute to team effectiveness.
* Experience in turbomachinery and Swedish language skills are a plus; advanced English proficiency is required.

**About the Team**


You will join a diverse R&D Compressor group of, more than, 20 skilled engineers specializing in aeromechanics, aerodynamics, mechanical integrity, structural dynamics, and rotor dynamics. Our team is dedicated to advancing compressor technology in a supportive, collaborative environment. Based in Finspång, we are recognized for our expertise and commitment to continuous development, always challenging ourselves and each other to stay at the forefront of innovation. As part of the Gas Services division, we deliver high-performance, low-emission power generation through advanced gas turbine technology. By driving decarbonization and modernization, we energize society and accelerate the global energy transition.


Our **Gas Services division** offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.


We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

**Who is Siemens Energy?**


At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.


Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.


Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

**Our Commitment to Diversity**


Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

For more information, visit www.shift4.com.

Global Blue by Shift4 is the industry leader in Tax Free Shopping solutions, simplifying the tax refund process for international travelers and driving revenue for retailers through a fully integrated commerce experience. As a business partner for the shopping journey, we seamlessly connect shoppers and brands worldwide, powering over 40 million transactions each year. This includes working with payment processing platforms, point-of-sale solutions, and other Shift4 technologies to ensure seamless transactions and optimal system performance. You will work closely with the international IT team as well as country sales- and refunding teams. You will be part of a truly international working environment that supports your professional development, fosters a collaborative and supportive team culture, and provides a competitive salary and benefits package.

* Performing network and system changes together or after preparation with 2nd level support teams
* Preparing specifications, installation and testing of computer systems and peripherals within established guidelines
* Contributing to audits
* Performing regular reviews
* Contributing to workflow optimizations and service catalogue setup

 **What we are looking for**  

We’re seeking a proactive and customer-focused professional who is passionate about delivering exceptional service and value. You are a team player but at the same time able to take own initiatives and responsibility from your work cases.

* Technical skills (1 year or more in one of the below areas):
* Windows 11, Android, Apple products
* O365 support
* Basic understanding of Azure and Intune is a plus
* Networking and telecommunications (WAN, LAN, VOIP) is a plus
* Basic understanding of payment processing and POS/payment terminal systems (e.g. Shift4) is a plus

* Independent, goal-oriented and self-motivating personality
* Organizational skills and the ability to prioritize workload
* Excellent communication skills, especially within a multicultural global organisation

**How to apply?**


If you recognize yourself as the candidate, we are looking for, apply now with your resume and brief cover letter including your salary/compensation request. We are reviewing the applications continuously and will fill the position as soon as we find our new Field Service Engineer.

title: Experienced Security Tools Engineer – Static Code Analysis, Lund
description:
**Job Title**
-------------


Experienced Security Tools Engineer – Static Code Analysis, Lund**Job Description**
-------------------

*Are you ready to be part of a Platform Engineering team that provides 900 developers with an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) that helps secure AXIS OS, the embedded Linux distribution that powers our products? This is an area where Axis is actively expanding, with continued investment that reflects its strategic importance to our product portfolio.*

 *As part of our security tooling sub-team, you will play a key role in static code analysis, today centered on Coverity, and help AXIS OS developers use it to find and fix vulnerabilities before they ship. The long-term ambition is to grow this into a broader static code analysis ecosystem over time. If you are passionate about application security and static analysis and are looking for the possibility to work with like-minded professionals, then this can be the perfect opportunity for you!*

 **Your future team**  

You will be part of a growing Platform Engineering team, divided into small, highly collaborative, and autonomous sub-teams. You will join our security tooling sub-team, responsible for the security-related tooling including vulnerability scanning and management, supply chain evaluation, and static code analysis. The IDP is built with a mix of open-source software, internally developed tools, and vendor licensed software. We’re active in several open-source communities and you’re encouraged to contribute to and engage with them.

  

You and your teammates own the sub-team backlog, and you are responsible for the evolution of your area of responsibility. You are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies, and your teammates will be available for feedback and support. We are great at what we do, and we are sure you will be inspired by our drive to always improve and learn more. The tools you will work on are used by AXIS OS developers every day and you will be challenged and learn much from working close with them to improve how the work, day to day.

  

Our culture is characterized by openness, trust, and collaboration. Work/life balance and hanging out with your teammates at common fikas, lunches, and other social activities are important to us and our success. Like the rest of Axis, we don’t let ourselves get stuck in rigid processes. Rather, we rely on the Axis Act As One spirit and work closely to achieve our shared goals.

**What will you do as a security tools engineer?**  

You will join our security tooling sub-team. Your initial focus will be on strengthening our work with Coverity, our static code analysis service, while also taking part in the sub-team's broader work. You will work in close collaboration with AXIS OS developers to understand their needs and pain points and how static analysis can support them in their daily work, as well as support the use of Coverity for compliance purposes.

  

This will give you an idea of what you’ll be working on:

* Configure and refine Coverity's static analysis capabilities to keep them effective for AXIS OS developers
* Support AXIS OS developers in how to use static code analysis effectively to find and resolve vulnerabilities and quality issues
* Work closely with AXIS OS product management to ensure that the Coverity setup supports compliance needs
* Work in close cooperation with AXIS OS developers to understand their needs and how we can help them by improving our tools and services
* Evaluate and introduce new features and capabilities related to static code analysis
* Collaborate with the rest of the security tooling team on vulnerability scanning, supply chain evaluation, and other security tooling initiatives
* Align with other area experts across the larger Platform Engineering team to share knowledge and make sure our tools and services fit into the bigger picture

**Who are we looking for/Who are you?**  

We are looking for an open, creative, and pragmatic problem solver that likes to combine long-term thinking and structure with the here and now that naturally follows from working closely with users. You are motivated by new challenges and are eager to learn, but you also get energy from helping others grow by sharing your knowledge. Like us, you value teamwork and want to contribute to our great team spirit. You have a security mindset and enjoy digging into how tools and processes can help developers write more secure, higher quality code.

**We would love to hear that you have:**

* University degree in Computer Science or a comparable qualification
* Professional experience with software development, with a genuine interest in application security and code quality
* Solid understanding of software development process and life cycle with focus on Continuous Integration (CI)
* Hands-on experience with static code analysis tools, e.g. Coverity, SonarQube, or similar
* Knowledge of C and C++ development, secure coding practices, and standards such as CERT C/C++ or MISRA C
* Experience with vulnerability management, supply chain security, or compliance work, e.g. the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) or ISO 27001
* An understanding of embedded development
* Experience with git and code review tools, e.g. Gerrit

**What Axis has to offer!**  

At Axis you will be able to grow as a developer and use your creativity to experiment and from time to time make mistakes that can be a valuable source of new knowledge. Working with tools that directly affect the security and quality of AXIS OS, you will get immediate feedback from the developers who rely on them. You will work closely with experienced experts, developers and testers that love to overcome technical challenges together. Our culture is characterized by openness, trust, and collaboration. Finally, check out Engineering at Axis to get an insight into who we are.

**Ready to Act?**  

Find out more from our recruiting manager Håkan Rick at 0733 35 90 23. We’re looking forward to reading your application!

----------------------


Permanent Employment**Posting End Date**
--------------------


2026-09-29*Certain roles at Axis require background checks, which means applicable verifications will be done in these recruitments.* *Notice will be provided before we take any action.*

We enable a smarter, safer world by creating innovative solutions for improving security and business performance. As a network technology company and industry leader, we offer solutions in video surveillance, access control, intercom, and audio systems, enhanced by intelligent analytics applications.


With around 6000 committed employees in over 50 countries, we collaborate with partners worldwide. description:
The European Spallation Source (ESS) is one of the largest science and technology infrastructure projects being built today. ESS will soon be the world’s most powerful source of neutrons, providing researchers with unique opportunities to explore the structure of materials at the atomic level. Neutron scattering at ESS will address critical questions in physics, chemistry, geology, materials science and life science.


**About the role:**



To help us realise our goal of being the most powerful neutron source in the world, we are now looking for an Automation & Control System Engineer to join the Automation Section, located within our Integrated Control Systems (ICS) Division.



The scope of the Automation Section is to design, develop, deliver and maintain control systems based on industrial automation technology such as Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC) and to integrate them with the EPICS (Experimental Physics and Industrial Control System) software infrastructure. The Automation Section develops and maintains also the control system operator interfaces (OPIs), as well as the archive and alarm configurations of the PLC-based control systems.



As an Automation and Control System Engineer at ESS your responsibilities will be the following:



* Lead the development, integration, verification, and validation of control systems, ensuring compliance with relevant procedures and standards.


* Define schedule and costs while exploring innovative approaches and conceptualizing solutions.


* Document design/development.


* Review other engineering designs.


* Stay current with emerging start-of-the-art technologies.


* Collaborate with system owners to facilitate successful deployment of integrated control systems.


* Provide technical support to team members on PLC technologies and EPICS integration.


* Develop and maintain key control projects, including the new PLC/EPICS Integrator tool.



This position is a full-time, permanent role with a 6-month probationary period. It is based at the brand-new ESS campus in Lund, Sweden. We would like this position to start as soon as practically possible.


**About you:**



We are seeking a proactive, self-motivated, responsible, structured Automation or Control Systems Engineer who is eager to grow in a fast-paced, impact-driven environment. You should enjoy working both independently and together with others within a team and are comfortable communicating with both in-house technical teams and external stakeholders.



The following qualifications and experience are **mandatory** for this position:


* A Master’s degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a **very** closely related field.
* Proven experience in control system design and implementation within a research facility or industrial setting.
* Strong expertise in:
	+ PLC programming, according to standard IEC 61131-3.
	+ Motion control systems.
* Knowledge of Python, C/C++ and Linux OS.
* Knowledge of Gitlab.
* Knowledge of the EPICS Framework.
* Experience with Beckhoff PLC.
* Proven ability in independent problem-solving and solution development.
* Excellent technical writing, reporting, and documentation skills.
* An excellent track record of working with configuration management tools, source code management tools and version control systems.
* Fluency in both oral and written English.


Experience in any of the following areas would be an advantage:


* Particle accelerator systems technology.
* Prior experience of working with EPICS software tools, including SNL and Sequencer module.
* Knowledge of pytest and PySide6 python modules.
* Siemens PLC and Siemens tools such as Openness and Test Suite Advanced.
* Prior experience of working in a complex, international project or plant.
* Experience of using collaborative electronic project management tools, such as Jira.
* Good communication skills in both written and spoken Swedish.


**To apply:**



A career at ESS gives you the opportunity to contribute to the future discoveries within neutron science at a stunning, brand-new workplace filled with innovative minds and brilliant people from across the globe. We offer market competitive, individualised compensation which is differentiated according to role, responsibilities, individual skills, abilities and achievements as well as monthly pension contributions on top of your salary.



If you see yourself in what we’re looking for, please provide your CV and motivation letter in English . Please be aware that we can only accept direct applications made via the ESS website. Submit your application as soon as you can and quote the job reference number ESD-82392 in your application.



This role might require enhanced security screening processes, which will be performed during the recruitment process if needed.



For further information regarding the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist Daniel Nordin Baker on Daniel.Nordin@ess.eu



For trade union information, please contact Unionen representative Nerusha Naicker on Nerusha.Naicker@ess.eu or SACO/Swedish Association of Graduate Engineers representative Marc Kickulies at marc.kickulies@ess.eu

title: Senior Systemutvecklare med Java
description:
**Om företaget**
 Hos Avaron får du tryggheten i en fast anställning kombinerat med variationen av att arbeta ute hos olika kunder. Vi tillsätter specialister inom allt från teknik, IT och industri till projektledning och affärsstöd – och oavsett uppdrag har du en konsultchef som finns där för dig och din utveckling.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Du kliver in i en samhällsviktig utvecklingsmiljö där digitala lösningar används varje dag i operativ verksamhet. Här får du arbeta nära system med höga krav på tillgänglighet, säkerhet och kvalitet, och bidra både i förvaltning och nyutveckling. Rollen spänner över flera tekniska områden, från etablerade stödsystem till mobila lösningar och komponenter inom infrastruktur, säkerhet och integration.
   

  

 En viktig del av arbetet är vidareutveckling och förvaltning av det interna systemet PUM-A. Du kommer också att vara med och bygga nya lösningar, bland annat ett system för trådlös överföring av data från ett instrument till en dator, där en iOS-applikation kommunicerar med en Windowsbaserad klient. Det här är en roll för dig som trivs med komplex systemutveckling, gillar att röra dig mellan verksamhetskrav och teknisk implementation och vill göra skillnad i en miljö där tekniken har tydlig påverkan.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
* Du utvecklar, vidareutvecklar och förvaltar system som stödjer operativ verksamhet.
* Du arbetar med PUM-A, både i befintlig kodbas och i teknisk vidareutveckling av lösningen.
* Du analyserar och tolkar verksamhetskrav och omsätter dem till design, implementation och test.
* Du utvecklar mobila lösningar och tekniska komponenter inom exempelvis integration, infrastruktur och säkerhet.
* Du bidrar i utvecklingen av en lösning för trådlös dataöverföring mellan instrument, iOS-applikation och Windowsklient.
* Du samarbetar tätt med andra kompetenser i agila team och är delaktig genom hela utvecklingsprocessen, från analys till felrättning och förvaltning.


**Krav**
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av arbete med PUM-A.
* Minst 9 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av systemutveckling, varav minst 5 år inom Java.
* Aktuell och relevant arbetslivserfarenhet av systemutveckling i agila team med flera olika kompetenser.
* Minst 7 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av systemutveckling inom offentlig sektor.
* Erfarenhet av att utveckla, vidareutveckla eller förvalta IT-lösningar som används av fler än 1 000 användare.
* God förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska.
* Möjlighet att genomgå och godkännas i en säkerhetsprövning (kräver svenskt medborgarskap, dubbla medborgarskap medges ej)


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av apputveckling för iOS, gärna i Swift.
* Erfarenhet av hårdvarunära utveckling.
* Erfarenhet av Windows, Linux, Jenkins och GitOps.
* Erfarenhet av Angular samt JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Erfarenhet av MySQL eller motsvarande databaser.
* Kunskap om OWASP Application Security Verification Standard (ASVS).
* Erfarenhet av prestandaoptimering, testautomatisering och AI/ML.


**Vi erbjuder**
* Fast anställning hos Avaron AB
* Tjänstepension
* Friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kr per år


**Ansökan**
 Vi tillsätter löpande – sök gärna så snart du kan.

title: Senior System Verification Engineer, Software
description:
**Mission**
 Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
   

  

 In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior System Verification Engineer, Software, you own and you are responsible for the system-level verification of our health software products. You define the test methods for system-level verification, develop the system tests those methods call for, and automate them, so software ships quickly and with high confidence in its safety, performance and compliance.
   

  

 You'll join the Verification & Validation team, which supports Neko’s regulated product portfolio spanning SaMD and health software, and hardware medical devices (instruments). The team is small, growing and fast-moving, with real room to shape engineering quality, verification strategy, and how products are built as we scale.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Plan, execute and document system-level verification for SaMD and health software products, including complex interconnected systems.
* Design and implement test methods for regression and end-to-end system testing
* Build and improve the test automation and infrastructure that make verification faster, more reliable and broader in coverage, integrated into the development and release pipelines.
* Turn software and system requirements into test methods and acceptance criteria, and work with software, data & AI and firmware engineers to make requirements clear, concrete and testable.
* Ensure that traceability matrices and V&V evidence are up to date so that every requirement is covered by verification throughout the product lifetime
* Automate the generation of audit-ready verification reports documenting results, defects and compliance status, and communicate findings to the teams that need them.
* Ensure verification activities comply applicable regulatory standards (IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 82304-1, ISO 13485, EU MDR, FDA 21 CFR Part 820).
* Contribute to continuous improvements on how the team documents and reports verification, so practice is consistent across projects.


**Must-have**
 About you
   

  

* Verification of software in a regulated setting: 5+ years in system-level verification of SaMD or comparable regulated software products.
* Test automation you built yourself: frameworks, scripting and tooling for integration, regression and end-to-end testing, integrated into CI and release pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins or equivalent).
* Programming fluency to read and reason about the code you are verifying
* From requirements to test methods: turning software and system requirements into verification strategies and acceptance criteria and saying so when a requirement is not testable as written.
* Software lifecycle depth: IEC 62304 lifecycle processes (or comparable), software risk management under ISO 14971, and system integration testing across interconnected systems.
* Verification that stands up in an audit: traceability matrices, V&V plans and audit-ready reports, in clear and structured English.
* A degree in a relevant technical field: Software, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Physics or similar.


**Nice To Have**
* Hands-on verification of software products built on machine learning or algorithms
* Verifying software that spans cloud services and mobile apps end to end.
* Contributing to FDA submissions, EU MDR technical files or Notified Body audits.
* Experience using AI tools and agents in your own work
* Setting up reporting and dashboarding for continuous verification (results, coverage, traceability) inside build pipelines.
* Working alongside embedded verification on products where software runs on our own hardware.


 Why this role matters
   

  

 Our software portfolio is growing faster than manual verification can scale, and it carries clinical decisions: what a member is told about a mole, a blood pressure reading or a heart signal. As a Senior System Verification Engineer, Software you build the verification that makes those answers trustworthy, and the automation that keeps it fast enough to ship frequently/regularly.

Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Senior Engineer Remote Connectivity and IoT** 
 to help us build secure, reliable, and scalable connectivity solutions for products used in the field.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who really understands IoT and remote connectivity, not just in theory, but in practice. We’re looking for a senior technical person who can help define how we should build connected solutions going forward, while also being comfortable getting into the details when needed.
   

  

 You work closely with backend developers and a Product Owner focused on remote connectivity. You’ll act as a technical expert in the team, supporting both roadmap discussions and day-to-day technical decisions.
   

  

 Location: Sundbyberg, Sweden.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and improve secure and reliable connectivity solutions for products connected to cloud platforms and remote systems.
* Work with connectivity architecture, remote access, integration, performance, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Take a broad technical view of the solution landscape and help define how connectivity should be designed going forward.
* Evaluate current ways of working and contribute to improved technical approaches, principles, and solution design.
* Dive into technical details when needed to understand how solutions are built today and how they can be strengthened over time.
* Support the manager and product owner with technical direction, architecture input, and solution design.
* Act as a senior technical expert who helps guide decisions and supports the team in building strong, scalable solutions.


**Qualifications**
* A degree in engineering, computer science, telecommunications, or similar
* Solid experience in IoT connectivity and remote access solutions
* Strong understanding of connected product architecture
* Experience designing scalable, reliable connectivity solutions
* Good knowledge of networking and protocols such as MQTT, TCP/IP, VPN, cellular, and ideally 5G
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure — cloud is especially important in this role
* Good understanding of cybersecurity for connected devices and systems
* Experience from products that send data from the field to backend or cloud platforms
* Ability to contribute to technical direction and architecture decisions
* Strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on mindset
* Ability to explain technical topics in a clear and practical way
* Fluent in English both spoken and written


**It’s also a plus if you have**
* Experience in backend development, for example Java/Spring Boot
* Experience from critical infrastructure or other industries with high demands on security and uptime


 We believe you have worked as a senior engineer, system architect, or product architect within IoT, connectivity, or connected products. You probably have experience from products that are already on the market and used in real environments.
   

  

 You might have worked with systems in water, pump stations, drinking water, energy, healthcare, automotive, industrial equipment, or other critical infrastructure. Exact industry is less important than having experience from connected products in real-world use.
   

  

**Why Work at Xylem!**
 We offer you a creative and international environment where you get the opportunity to focus on your personal and professional development together with committed and helpful colleagues. Engage as a volunteer through Xylem´s business program for community initiatives Xylem Watermark: www.xylemwatermark.com
 **.**
**Everyone's equal value**
 We want people, regardless of skin color, age, disability, sexual orientation and gender identity, to feel at home, not just on Xylem, but everywhere in the world. For us, diversity means more than just a policy or a set of methods. Diversity is a fundamental part of our corporate culture and a key to long-term growth.
   

  

 Feel free to visit us at https://www.xylem.com/sv-se/
   

  

**Application**
 We look forward to receiving your application in English. Please note that we will be interviewing continuously, which means that we may close the application process if we find the right candidate.
   

  

 If you have any questions regarding this position, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Leila Sayyad, Leila.sayyad@xylem.com.
   

  

 We only accept applicants through Sök efter jobb
 **.**
 Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

title: Senior Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE
